title: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
abstract: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh$_6$/In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.
summary:
1. 该工作提出LatticeMind，一个把自然语言请求转成可执行、可校验DFT项目的验证门控智能体框架，针对多阶段第一性原理工作流。
2. 其核心是以工作流契约规定阶段、文件与依赖，在求解器启动前由确定性校验器检查并触发有界修复，且记录可追溯至项目文件，从而拦截交接错误与幻觉关键词。
3. 在RESCU 44例中三个非旗舰LLM后端复现全部参考值，119/132首轮通过、其余一轮修复通过，并在VASP 19例及Rh6/InxGa1-xN界面23输入案例中显示迁移，表明契约、预执行校验和有界修复是可靠AI辅助科学计算的可实践基础。

title: Zeeman Quantum Geometry of the Layer Pseudo-spin
abstract: Two-dimensional layers coupled by position-dependent interlayer tunnelling host a layer pseudo-spin whose polarization is a controllable internal degree of freedom. We introduce the quantum geometry of this layer pseudo-spin: a mixed tensor formed from the interband Berry connection and the layer matrix element, which governs the response to an oscillating in-plane electric field. Because the layer pseudo-spin is an Ising-type scalar invariant under threefold rotation, its selection rules differ from those of a pseudovector spin. In a minimal two-band model, the layer-pseudo-spin quantum metric and Zeeman--Berry curvature are nonzero, while their zone integrals vanish. An in-plane drive therefore leaves the spatially averaged polarization unchanged at linear order but imprints a moiré-periodic intracell pattern, directly imageable by layer-resolved tunnelling. For twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayer, we quantify the local dipole modulation and identify the rectified, helicity-odd, and third-harmonic channels through which a net response appears at higher order.
summary:
1. 该工作引入层赝自旋的量子几何，以带间Berry联络与层矩阵元构成的混合张量刻画其对振荡面内电场的响应。
2. 其关键在于层赝自旋在三重旋转下为Ising型标量、选择规则异于赝矢量自旋；最小两带模型中量子度规与Zeeman-Berry曲率非零而区积分消失，线性驱动仅留下可由层分辨隧穿成像的莫尔周期胞内极化图案。
3. 对扭转MoTe2双层量化局域偶极调制并识别整流、螺旋度奇和三次谐波通道，说明净响应需在更高阶显现。

title: Heat-current-induced nonreciprocal phonon damping
abstract: Time-reversal symmetry enforces equal equilibrium linewidths for time-reversed phonon modes at opposite wave vectors. Here we show that a steady heat current can produce nonreciprocal anharmonic damping even in centrosymmetric nonmagnetic crystals. The effect arises from nonequilibrium occupations of scattering partners, which change the statistical weights of time-reversed three-phonon channels while their squared matrix elements remain equal. Within the single-mode relaxation-time approximation, we derive a linewidth correction that is linear in the temperature gradient and odd under wave-vector reversal. The response depends on scattering-partner velocities and equilibrium lifetimes and retains signed channel weights absent from the equilibrium linewidth. First-principles calculations for centrosymmetric MgO and diamond yield nonzero, mode-dependent linewidth corrections at selected finite wave vectors, demonstrating the mechanism in both ionic and covalent crystals. Reversing the heat current at fixed local temperature exchanges the broadening and narrowing of paired modes. This current-reversible linewidth contrast provides a spectral signature of occupation feedback, with potential implications for nonlinear phonon transport.
summary:
1. 该工作证明稳定热流可在中心对称非磁性晶体中产生非互易的非谐声子阻尼，并在单模弛豫时间近似下给出线性的线宽修正。
2. 其机制是非平衡占据改变时间反演三声子通道的统计权重而保持矩阵元平方相等，使修正正比于温度梯度、在波矢反演下变号，并依赖散射伙伴速度与平衡寿命；对MgO和金刚石的第一性原理计算给出有限波矢下非零且依赖模式的线宽修正。
3. 固定局域温度下反转热流会交换成对模式的展宽与窄化，可作为占据反馈的光谱特征，并对非线性声子输运研究提供启发。

title: Field Theory of the Gutzwiller Projection
abstract: The Gutzwiller projection produces a well-known ansatz for spin-liquid and quantum Hall ground-state wavefunctions that is amenable to numerical simulation, with the Laughlin wavefunction being the most celebrated example. A long-standing issue is the precise relation between the Gutzwiller projection and the closely related parton gauge theory. Here, we clarify this issue by providing a field-theoretic description of the Gutzwiller projection. In a path integral description, the universal physics of the projected state is described in terms of a gauge field supported on a temporal slab of vanishing width $\epsilon \rightarrow 0$ coupled to the bulk matter fields. We analytically derive the universal physics of various Gutzwiller projected states. Our construction is also applicable to discrete symmetries, and we use it to analyze various projected SPT states. Among our results, we show that the Gutzwiller projection is not a good ansatz for the long-distance properties of $U(1)$ Dirac spin liquids, spinon Fermi surface spin liquids or composite Fermi liquids, and that the Gutzwiller projection of a quantum spin Hall state has only quasi-long range order. In contrast, in examples where the gauge field is gapped, including Laughlin states, $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin liquids and Luttinger liquids, we show that the slab gauge theory from Gutzwiller projection reproduces the correct universal physics of the full parton gauge theory. We also present a generalization of our field theory that describes $G$-intertwining defects, with application to self-duality defects of recent theoretical interest.
summary:
1. 该工作提出古茨维勒投影的路径积分场论，用宽度趋于零的时间薄层规范场耦合体态物质场，解析给出多类投影态及离散对称性下对称保护拓扑态的普适物理。
2. 其核心是澄清投影与部分子规范理论的精确关系：规范场有能隙时薄层理论重现部分子普适物理（拉夫林态、Z2自旋液体、卢廷格液体），无能隙时投影不能正确描述U(1)狄拉克自旋液体、自旋子费米面自旋液体或复合费米液体的长程行为，量子自旋霍尔态投影仅具准长程有序。
3. 该框架还推广至G-交错缺陷与自对偶缺陷，为判别投影波函数能否忠实编码部分子规范理论的长程物理提供判据，并对对称保护拓扑缺陷分析有启发。

title: An efficient approach to electron-phonon coupling calculations of heterostructures within an all-electron framework
abstract: A major challenge in calculating electron-phonon coupling at interfaces from first principles is the prohibitive computational cost due to the large supercells involved. Here, we present an efficient approach, which builds the electron-phonon matrix of weakly bound heterostructures from the properties of the isolated layers. The two key ingredients, the dynamical matrices and the potential response, are constructed in two steps. In the expansion step, these quantities are folded from the unit cells onto the supercell through an exact Fourier mapping. In the addition step, the interatomic force constants and the potential responses of the heterostructure are assembled blockwise from the corresponding quantities of the isolated layers, neglecting the weak interlayer contribution. The method is implemented in the electron-phonon module of the all-electron full-potential code exciting, enabling efficient calculations of the electron-phonon self-energy. We demonstrate the approach for the phonon dispersion and spectral functions of bilayer WSe$_2$ and pyridine/MoS$_2$, in comparison with exact reference calculations.
summary:
1. 该工作提出一种在全电子框架下高效计算异质结电子-声子耦合的方法，通过由孤立层性质构建弱束缚异质结的电子-声子矩阵。
2. 其核心是将动力学矩阵和势响应先经精确傅里叶映射折叠到超胞，再按块由各孤立层量组装并忽略弱层间贡献，且在 exciting 代码中实现并用于双层 WSe₂ 与吡啶/MoS₂ 的声子色散和谱函数验证。
3. 该方法可显著降低界面电子-声子自能计算对超大超胞的依赖，为弱耦合范德华异质结的谱学与输运研究提供可行途径，但其精度依赖于层间相互作用较弱的近似。

title: Exact spectral integrability of a finite-channel random Schrödinger operator: from fermionization of the Dyson--Riccati gas to Kontsevich integral
abstract: We solve exactly, for arbitrary finite channel number $N$, the Riccati dynamics of a quasi-one-dimensional random matrix Schrödinger operator with Hermitian white-noise potential in the $\beta=2$ unitary symmetry class. The associated Dyson--Riccati eigenvalue gas admits an exact free-fermion representation at any sample length $L$, which in the limit $L\to \infty$ expresses the density of states and the total Lyapunov growth rate exactly through a single Airy Hankel $\tau$-function providing multichannel generalization of $N=1$ Halperin--Thouless formulas. The $\tau-$function further admits an outgoing-contour Kontsevich matrix Airy integral representation. Its saddle-point and double-scaling analyses give, in a unified way, the finite-channel density Lifshitz tail, and the large-$N$ spectral edge. In particular, for $N\gg 1$ the sharp $N=\infty$ edge is softened within an $N^{-4/5}$ spectral window, with its profile governed by the tritronquée solution of Painlevé I. We conjecture universality of this quasi-one-dimensional scaling edge profile for a broad class of $\beta=2$ random band matrices.
summary:
1. 该文对任意有限通道数 N 的准一维 β=2 随机矩阵薛定谔算子（厄米白噪声势）精确求解 Riccati 动力学，并给出任意长度下 Dyson–Riccati 本征值气体的自由费米子表示。
2. 其核心是把 L→∞ 的态密度与总 Lyapunov 增长率统一写成单个 Airy Hankel τ 函数，并进一步表示为出射围道 Kontsevich 矩阵 Airy 积分，从而统一导出有限通道 Lifshitz 尾与大 N 谱边软化（N^{-4/5} 窗口、Painlevé I tritronquée 剖面）。
3. 作者据此猜想该准一维标度谱边剖面在一大类 β=2 随机带矩阵中具有普适性，为多通道局域化与谱边研究提供了可检验的框架。

title: Diffusive Description of Superconducting Single-Photon Detectors Using Quantum Mechanics
abstract: The methodology of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics is employed to parameterize the dynamics of coupled classical diffusion equations describing low- and high-energy quasiparticles in superconducting single-photon detectors in one to three spatial dimensions.
summary:
1. 该工作采用非厄米量子力学方法，对描述超导单光子探测器中低能和高能准粒子动力学的耦合经典扩散方程进行参数化，并给出一至三维空间中的弥散型描述。
2. 其技术核心是用非厄米框架参数化耦合经典扩散方程的动力学，以在同一形式下刻画低能与高能准粒子的扩散及耦合过程。
3. 该参数化为统一建模超导单光子探测器的准粒子弛豫、扩散与响应提供了可扩展工具，并可启发其他耦合耗散系统的非厄米处理。

title: Density Accelerated Relaxation in Active Passive Colloidal Networks with Competing Interactions
abstract: We investigate quasi-2D active-passive colloidal mixtures with electric field-mediated non-identical interactions: unlike species attract and like species repel. Mapping the steady states across total area fraction and active particle area fraction identifies the regime of active percolated network formation among active fluid and clustered states. Within the percolated network regime, relaxation speeds up with increasing density, contrary to expectations for dense particulate gels. Particle-resolved dynamics and microstructure link this acceleration to activity-driven rearrangements enabled by asymmetric interactions.
summary:
1. 该工作构建准二维活性-被动胶体混合物，利用电场介导的异类吸引、同类排斥相互作用，扫描总面积分数与活性粒子面积分数并绘制稳态图，识别出活性渗流网络区。
2. 其核心卖点是在该渗流网络区内观察到弛豫随密度升高而加速，与致密颗粒凝胶的通常预期相反，并通过粒子分辨动力学与微结构将其归因于不对称相互作用促发的活性重排。
3. 这揭示了密度、活性渗流网络与不对称相互作用对弛豫的耦合调控，为设计可调弛豫的活性胶体网络及检验非平衡凝胶理论提供了明确启发。

title: Soft elasticity of soft shells
abstract: Soft modes of a shell are one-parameter families of non-trivial deformations that preserve the elastic energy. We identify all soft modes of the soft shells described by the variational theory of put forward by Sonnet and Virga (2025). They are seen to be strictly connected with the Bonnet families, a special class of solutions to the problem posited by Bonnet, who asked whether there exist non-trivial isometries that preserve the mean curvature. Differential geometry deems as equivalent all surfaces in one and the same Bonnet family, but continuum mechanics is interested more specifically in soft deformation modes and the shapes they traverse, as they may describe ways to ignite fluctuations of soft shells that ideally require no energy to be activated. We give a general criterion for the existence of soft modes and a method to construct them based on a cascade of path integrations. We apply both criterion and method to some exemplary cases.
summary:
1. 该工作系统识别了Sonnet–Virga软壳变分理论中的全部软模，并阐明它们与Bonnet族严格相关。
2. 其技术卖点在于给出软模存在的通用判据和基于级联路径积分的构造方法，将零能变形模式与保平均曲率的等距曲面族对应起来。
3. 这为理解理想上无需能量激活的软壳涨落及其遍历形状提供框架，并对后续理论分析和实验设计具有明确启发。

title: Fully Automated Wannier Disentanglement via Projectability Selection in Gaussian and Augmented Plane-Wave Frameworks
abstract: Constructing the frozen manifold for entangled bands requires balancing exact reproduction of the target bands with sufficient variational freedom to build a well-localized subspace from the broader Bloch pool. We present a workflow that systematically determines the energy ceiling for a target number of selected Wannier projections, freezing every Bloch state below this threshold across the sampled k-mesh. By measuring projectability, the spectral weight of each Bloch state projected onto the target localized basis, the workflow detects missing conduction channels and quantifies discrepancies between orbital character and energy-based freezing. In comparisons where we controlled the extent of the energy ceiling, freezing all sub-ceiling states is generally favored over projectability-based frozen states. Of the seven materials we tested, freezing all sub-ceiling states lowers the band error on four from between 11 meV and 1.2 eV to 18 meV or less, and matches the projectability-based choice to within about 2 meV on the remaining three. In each of the four, projectability-based frozen states give the lower spread, showing that spread alone cannot identify the better model. With the frozen states held fixed, the workflow minimizes the gauge-invariant spread, constructs the gauge from density-matrix columns on atomic orbitals, and passes an isolated set of bands to Wannier90 for localization. The workflow is implemented in two programs for seamless high-throughput Wannierization with WIEN2k (wien2wannier) and CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier). Using a single set of calibrated defaults, the CRYSTAL implementation with analytic overlaps produces models that reproduce the reference bands of five cells, from bulk h-BN in a joint valence-and-conduction model to a magnetic framework with 1424 orbitals. The WIEN2k implementation produces eight such models from seven calculations.
summary:
1. 该工作提出并实现了一套面向纠缠能带的全自动万尼尔解纠缠流程，按目标投影数系统确定能量上限，并在采样波矢网格上冻结阈值以下的布洛赫态。
2. 其卖点是用投影度——布洛赫态在目标局域基上的谱权重——检测缺失传导通道、量化轨道特征与能量冻结的偏差，并在固定冻结空间后由原子轨道密度矩阵列构造规范、最小化规范不变展宽后交给万尼尔局域化。
3. 该流程在高斯与增强平面波框架的两套程序中实现，以单套校准默认参数支持高通量建模，表明冻结全部阈值以下态通常更稳健，并可推广至含一千四百二十四个轨道的磁性框架等复杂体系。

title: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
abstract: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in $T_c$. These results establish trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations, connecting property prediction with the exploration of materials space.
summary:
1. 该工作利用在训练参数处评估的神经正切核，恢复仅凭元素组成预测超导转变温度的神经网络所学到的材料空间几何。
2. 其核心在于训练后核的核岭回归可近乎复现网络预测并显著优于初始核，谱分析与多维标度显示几何由少数方向主导，聚类和局部邻域分析则将化合物组织为可识别的超导家族，并在Tc差异较大时连接化学与关联电子性质相关的材料。
3. 这表明训练后的切核可作为探测学习到的材料表示的可实用工具，将性质预测与材料空间探索直接联系起来。

title: Chiral magnetic excitations in the RMn6Sn6 kagome metals (R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y)
abstract: Recent inelastic neutron scattering (INS) investigations of the kagome metal TbMn6Sn6 reveal novel chiral magnetic excitations associated with the kagome layer. These excitations appear to have an itinerant character with a large energy scale (> 100 meV) and heavy damping; however, the origin of these excitations, which are not predicted by local moment linear spin-wave theory, is not understood. Here, we use INS to show that chiral excitations are also found in RMn6Sn6 compounds with R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y having uniaxial, tilted, planar ferrimagnet, and planar double-spiral magnetic structures, respectively. Thus, the chiral excitations exist regardless of the magnetic structure. Additionally, R=Er and Y demonstrate that the chiral mode intensity is weaker in planar magnetic structures, suggesting that excitations are transverse to the local Mn moment direction. The chiral excitations appear only at L=odd positions in the Brilloun zone, and correspond to chiral spin exciations of the same handedness within each kagome layer, and pi out-of-phase between layers.
summary:
1. 该工作利用非弹性中子散射，在R=Tb、Ho、Er、Y的RMn6Sn6 kagome金属中系统观测到手性磁激发，并覆盖单轴、倾斜、面内铁磁及面内双螺旋等不同磁结构。
2. 其关键点在于手性模不依赖磁结构而普遍存在，仅出现在布里渊区L为奇数的位置，且同一kagome层内手性一致、层间相位差为π；Er与Y的面内结构强度较弱，表明激发相对局域Mn矩方向横向。
3. 这将手性激发确立为kagome层的内禀共同特征，并对超出局域矩线性自旋波图像的理论解释及后续中子散射研究提出明确约束与方向。

title: Steering of topological criticality in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain via non-Hermitian substitutional impurities
abstract: We investigate the topological phase in a one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain in the presence of a finite concentration of non-Hermitian substitutional impurities. Our primary focus is the discovery of a deterministic mechanism to actively reconfigure the topological phase boundaries by introducing site-dependent, non-reciprocal intracell and intercell hopping amplitudes. Specifically, breaking the internal structural symmetry of the non-reciprocal impurity hoppings induces a targeted macroscopic displacement of the critical point. This mechanism allows for the controlled expansion or compression of the topological phase strictly via local defect asymmetry. We validate this boundary displacement through finite-size scaling analysis. The extracted correlation length critical exponents ($\nu \approx 1.455$ and $\nu \approx 1.397$ for symmetric and asymmetric configurations, respectively) confirm a disorder-induced departure from the pristine SSH universality class, with the exponent diverging at high defect densities. We also report an impurity-induced real-to-complex spectral transition geometrically characterized by the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect. Ultimately, our results establish how isolated non-Hermitian asymmetries cooperatively interact to deterministically shift macroscopic topological protection.
summary:
1. 该工作研究有限浓度非厄米替代杂质下一维SSH链的拓扑相，提出以位点依赖的非互易胞内/胞间跃迁主动重构相边界的确定性机制。
2. 其卖点是打破非互易杂质跃迁的内部结构对称性即可定向宏观移动临界点，仅凭局域缺陷不对称性受控扩张或压缩拓扑相，并由有限尺寸标度提取偏离原始SSH普适类的临界指数（约1.455与1.397，高缺陷密度下发散），同时伴随由非厄米趋肤效应表征的实-复谱转变。
3. 这表明孤立非厄米不对称性可协同确定性地移动宏观拓扑保护边界，为通过缺陷工程调控拓扑临界性与非厄米谱转变提供了明确启发。

title: Magnetic-Field-Induced Darkening of Bright Excitons in a MoWSe$_2$ Monolayer Alloy
abstract: Magnetic fields are widely used to brighten spin-forbidden dark excitons, but the inverse effect on an optically bright exciton has remained largely unexplored. We demonstrate the complementary phenomenon of magnetic-field-induced darkening of a bright exciton in Mo$_{0.68}$W$_{0.32}$Se$_2$. At 4.2 K, an in-plane magnetic field up to 25 T activates a dark-exciton line 14.2$\pm$1.3 meV below the bright exciton while suppressing the bright-exciton emission by about 85\%. A bright-dark mixing model quantitatively captures the coupled energy and intensity evolution with an effective in-plane $g$ factor of $|g_{\parallel}|=5.2\pm0.2$. Alloying is crucial to the effect, as it brings the system close to the bright-dark crossover, where a small bright-dark splitting is combined with unusually strong in-plane magnetic coupling. This places the system in a regime where field-induced level repulsion raises the bright-like branch and strongly depletes its thermal population. These results identify a general route to magnetic control of exciton populations through engineering of the bright-dark hierarchy.
summary:
1. 该工作在Mo0.68W0.32Se2单层合金中演示了面内磁场诱导的亮激子变暗：4.2 K、最高25 T下亮激子发光被抑制约85%，并激活其下方14.2±1.3 meV的暗激子线。
2. 其核心在于亮-暗激子混合模型定量再现能量与强度随磁场的协同演化，给出有效面内g因子|g∥|=5.2±0.2，并归因于合金使体系接近亮-暗交叉、小劈裂叠加强面内耦合导致能级排斥与热布居耗竭。
3. 这提供了通过调控亮-暗激子层级实现激子布居磁控制的通用路径，可启发合金设计与磁场实验。

title: Rashba-controlled emergence and reversal of critical-field anisotropy in p-wave magnet--superconductor hybrids
abstract: We show that tuning Rashba spin-orbit coupling can change the in-plane field direction along which an $s$-wave superconductor is most susceptible to Zeeman depairing. We consider a two-dimensional $s$-wave superconductor subject to an odd-parity exchange field induced by a $p$-wave magnet. Without Rashba coupling, the out-of-plane exchange field enhances the in-plane critical field but leaves its angular response exactly isotropic, despite the anisotropic magnetic spin texture. Minimizing the Bogoliubov--de Gennes grand potential over uniform singlet pairing, we find that increasing Rashba coupling first generates and then reverses the principal-axis critical-field contrast, switching the minimum-critical-field direction by $90^{\circ}$. Equal principal-axis fields at the intervening compensation point coexist with residual angular modulation. We interpret the reversal through competing momentum-dependent depairing contributions from the magnetic and Rashba spin textures, while the on-site singlet pairing channel remains unchanged. Direction-dependent discontinuous collapses of the order parameter further shape the critical-field curves. These results identify a tunable directional paramagnetic response within the uniform-pairing sector. In heterostructures with sufficient electrostatic tunability of interfacial Rashba coupling, this reversal would enable gate control of the easy-depairing axis without reorienting the magnetic texture.
summary:
1. 该工作理论上研究了由p波磁体诱导奇宇称交换场的二维s波超导体，通过调节Rashba自旋轨道耦合改变面内临界场的各向异性与易去配对方向。
2. 其关键在于：无Rashba时面内临界场角度响应严格各向同性；增强Rashba先产生并随后反转主轴临界场对比，使最小临界场方向切换90°，补偿点两主轴临界场相等但仍残留角度调制，可归因于磁性与Rashba自旋织构的动量依赖去配对竞争，而原位单重态配对通道不变。
3. 这揭示了均匀配对区域内可调的方向性顺磁响应，并启示在界面Rashba耦合可栅极调控的异质结中，无需重取向磁织构即可电控易去配对轴。

title: Magnetic-Field Effects on the Electronic States of the K$_4$ Lattice
abstract: We investigate the electronic states of the K$_4$ lattice in a uniform magnetic field within a nearest-neighbor tight-binding model. The K$_4$ lattice is a \rev{noncentrosymmetric three-dimensional network with triple-Dirac cones at the $\Gamma$ and H points}. By fixing the Bloch momentum component parallel to the field, the Peierls-substituted tight-binding problem reduces to an effective two-dimensional problem and yields a Hofstadter spectrum \rev{whose self-similar subpatterns reflect the geometry of the lattice projected onto the plane perpendicular to the field}. A square-like substructure emerges on the flux scale $\phi = 1/8$ for $\bm{B}\parallel[100]$, and honeycomb- and triangular-like substructures emerge on the finer scale $\phi = 1/32$ for $\bm{B}\parallel[111]$\rev{. Here $\phi$ is the flux through the elementary plaquette of the projected lattice, and these scales correspond to one flux quantum per projected unit cell. Owing to the screw axes of the chiral K$_4$ network, the field-parallel momentum acts as an additional flux, which, for commensurate values of this momentum, shifts the spectrum along the flux axis and brings the second triple-Dirac cone at the H point into the magnetic spectrum}. In the weak-field limit, we derive the Landau-level structure from a low-energy effective Hamiltonian around the $\Gamma$ point. The three-component nature of the triple-Dirac cone gives rise to a cubic secular equation, whose solutions describe how a pseudospin-flat branch coexists with two relativistic Landau ladders \rev{and a single chiral $n=0$ level dispersing linearly along the field, in agreement with the lattice calculation}.
summary:
1. 该工作在均匀磁场下用最近邻紧束缚模型研究非中心对称三维K4格子的电子态，并固定平行磁场的Bloch动量以约化为有效二维Hofstadter问题。
2. 其卖点是投影晶格几何决定Hofstadter子图样：B∥[100]时φ=1/8出现类方形结构，B∥[111]时φ=1/32出现类蜂窝与三角结构；螺旋轴使场平行动量充当额外磁通，并在公度值下把H点第二三重Dirac锥带入磁谱。
3. 弱场下Γ点有效哈密顿量给出三重Dirac锥的三分量久期方程，预言赝自旋平坦支、两个相对论朗道梯子与沿场线性色散的单一手性n=0能级共存，并与格点计算一致。

title: Finite-temperature spectral functions of lattice polarons with process tensors
abstract: We develop a process tensor approach for calculating the finite-temperature spectral functions of lattice polarons. We show that the finite-temperature phonon influence functional can be expressed as the elementwise exponential of a low-rank matrix product state, enabling an efficient summation of electron worldlines. An embedding construction embeds worldlines of different propagation times into a single matrix product state. This construction yields the propagator over the full simulated time interval in a single calculation. We benchmark this approach against available finite-temperature density-matrix renormalization group results for the one-dimensional Holstein polaron. We further obtain numerically converged spectra for the two-dimensional Holstein polaron. The spectra reveal a progressive transfer of spectral weight from coherent spectral features into an incoherent background with increasing temperature.
summary:
1. 该工作发展了基于过程张量的方法，用于计算晶格极化子的有限温度谱函数，并在一维Holstein模型上与有限温度DMRG结果进行基准对比，进一步给出二维Holstein极化子的数值收敛谱。
2. 其核心技术是将有限温度声子影响泛函表示为低秩矩阵乘积态的逐元素指数，并通过嵌入构造把不同传播时间的电子世界线合并到单个矩阵乘积态中，从而在一次计算中取得整个模拟时间区间的传播子并高效求和世界线。
3. 所得谱显示，随温度升高，谱权重由相干谱特征逐步转移至非相干背景；这为高维极化子有限温度谱的可控张量网络计算及与DMRG等方法的交叉验证提供了明确途径。

title: Orbital Magnetization within Self-Consistent Hartree-Fock via an Envelope Theorem
abstract: Orbital magnetization is an elementary thermodynamic response function of a quantum system: the derivative of the grand potential with respect to magnetic field. However, naive perturbation theory is fraught with difficulties, as even infinitesimal magnetic fields shatter any bands into a Hofstadter butterfly spectrum. Even at the self-consistent Hartree-Fock (mean field) level, rigorous formulas for the orbital magnetization have only become available within the last year. This work provides a straightforward derivation of orbital magnetization at the mean field level using a completely real-space approach. The key tools used are the magnetic perturbation theory developed in the 1960s and an envelope theorem, which is a standard result in the calculus of variations. For simplicity, we restrict to insulating states at zero temperature on the infinite plane. We also discuss the natural connections to projected position operators and quantum geometry, as well as practical numerical computations.
summary:
1. 该工作在零温绝缘体与无穷平面的设定下，于自洽Hartree-Fock平均场层面给出轨道磁化的完全实空间推导。
2. 其关键卖点是结合20世纪60年代的磁微扰论与变分法中的包络定理，绕开微小磁场诱发Hofstadter蝴蝶谱的朴素微扰困难，得到严格的平均场公式。
3. 该框架自然联系投影位置算符与量子几何，并讨论实际数值计算，为平均场轨道磁化的计算及后续响应研究提供了可操作启发。

title: Persistent Photo-Enhancement of Molecular Orbital Excitations in the Kondo Insulator FeSb$_2$
abstract: When insulators are excited by photons with above-gap energies, photo-doped carriers are transiently generated. Typically, orbital excitations weaken and broaden due to increased screening by these transient carriers, followed by a few-ps recovery via phonon thermalization. Here we report the observation of anomalous dynamics of many-body molecular orbital excitations in the narrow-gap Kondo insulator FeSb$_2$. In the pumped X-ray absorption spectra following excitation with 1~$\mu$m photons, we observe a transient transfer of absorption intensity from the delocalized states at the main absorption peak to the localized molecular orbital states at the pre-edge. At the resonance of the low-energy molecular orbital excitations, the pumped resonant inelastic X-ray spectra show an approximately 30\% intensity increase at a pump fluence of 11 mJ/cm$^2$ concomitant with the emergence of an energy gain feature. While the energy gain feature disappears after about 1-2~ps, the increased molecular orbital excitation intensities partially persist for at least 50~ps with no discernible energy shift. These observations require the invocation of a many-body excitation picture beyond single particle population changes.
summary:
1. 该工作利用1 μm光子激发后的时间分辨X射线吸收谱与共振非弹性X射线散射，追踪了窄带隙近藤绝缘体FeSb2中分子轨道激发的异常超快动力学。
2. 其核心卖点是观测到吸收强度由主峰离域态向预边局域分子轨道态瞬态转移，并在11 mJ/cm²通量下于低能分子轨道共振处出现约30%的RIXS强度增强和能量增益特征；后者约1–2 ps消失，而增强可部分持续至少50 ps且无能量移动，需用多体激发图像而非单粒子布居变化解释。
3. 这为理解窄带隙近藤绝缘体中光掺杂与局域分子轨道激发的非平衡多体耦合提供了实验依据，并提示传统屏蔽增强与声子热化恢复图像需要修正。

title: Lattice symmetry breaking and strain control of single-$\mathbf{q}$ magnetism in Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$
abstract: Distinguishing single-$\mathbf{q}$ from multi-$\mathbf{q}$ magnetism constrains microscopic spin Hamiltonians. Here we determine the ground state of the candidate Kitaev magnet Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ through its coupling to the lattice. High-resolution neutron diffraction reveals a spontaneous monoclinic-to-triclinic distortion at the magnetic transition, in contrast to the absence of detectable lattice-symmetry breaking in triple-$\mathbf{q}$ Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$. Together with strain-selective magnetic responses, this identifies single-$\mathbf{q}$ order in Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ over the proposed symmetry-preserving double-$\mathbf{q}$ state. Uniaxial compression along a low-symmetry in-plane direction achieves the domain selection that magnetic-field training could not, revealing the intrinsic field-induced phase boundaries of the dominant domain. These results establish strain as a symmetry-conjugate field for magnetic domains and highlight magnetoelastic coupling as a route to diagnose, manipulate, and potentially tune magnetic states.
summary:
1. 该工作利用高分辨中子衍射与应变响应，确定候选Kitaev磁体Na3Co2SbO6的磁基态为单q序，而非先前提出的对称保持双q态。
2. 核心证据是磁转变处自发单斜—三斜畸变（三q Na2Co2TeO6无可测晶格对称破缺）及应变选择性磁响应，并沿低对称面内方向单轴压缩实现磁场训练无法达成的磁畴选择，揭示主导畴的本征场致相边界。
3. 这将应变确立为磁畴的对称共轭场，表明磁弹耦合可用于诊断、操控乃至调节磁态，并为甄别单q与多q基态提供可检验途径。

title: Pressure-induced superconductivity in a bilayer metal
abstract: We propose a model that explains the mechanism of pressure-induced superconductivity in a bilayer metal. Four types of pair potentials are assumed for a Cooper pair consisting of two electrons on different layers. Absence of local inversion symmetry gives rise to the spin-orbit coupling which is antisymmetric in the two layers. We assume that external pressure enhances the hybridization between the two layers. The stability of the superconducting states is well explained by the frequency symmetry of the induced pairing correlations by these potentials. Pressure-induced superconductivity emerges when the following two conditions are realized. (i) The spin-orbit coupling induces the odd-frequency pairing correlations and suppresses superconductivity at ambient pressure. (ii) The interplay between the spin-orbit coupling and the hybridization induces the additional pairing correlation that belongs to an even-frequency symmetry class. We briefly discuss the relevance of our model to real materials.
summary:
1. 该工作提出了一个双层金属模型，以四种跨层库珀对势解释压力诱导超导的机制，并简要讨论其与真实材料的关联。
2. 其关键卖点是把局域反演对称破缺导致的层间反对称自旋轨道耦合与压力增强的层间杂化结合起来，用配对关联的频率对称性解释超导态的稳定性。
3. 模型给出常压下奇频配对关联抑制超导、加压后自旋轨道耦合与杂化协同诱导偶频配对关联而触发超导的判据，可为双层或层状金属中压力调控超导及材料筛选提供启发。

title: Symmetry Enriched Criticality from Kennedy Tasaki Self-Duality
abstract: The interplay between topology and quantum criticality has established symmetry enriched criticality as a new paradigm beyond conventional frameworks in condensed matter and statistical physics. However, the conditions under which such criticality emerges remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that a broad class of symmetry enriched critical points separating symmetry protected topological (SPT) and spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) phases is governed by Kennedy Tasaki (KT) self duality. At these criticalities, the KT transformation that interchanges the SPT and SSB phases acts as a self-dual noninvertible symmetry, endowing the critical points with nontrivial topological characteristics. We numerically demonstrate this mechanism in $\mathbb{Z}_{n} \times \mathbb{Z}_{n}$ cluster qudit chains and further argue that it naturally extends to higher dimensions, providing a duality based criterion for identifying symmetry-enriched criticality across dimensions.
summary:
1. 该工作揭示了一类分隔对称保护拓扑相与自发对称破缺相的对称富集临界点由肯尼迪-塔萨基自对偶支配，并在Z_n×Z_n簇量子链中数值验证该机制。
2. 其核心卖点是交换这两类相的肯尼迪-塔萨基变换在临界点充当自对偶非可逆对称性，赋予临界点非平凡拓扑特征，并由此给出跨维度识别对称富集临界性的对偶判据。
3. 这一机制可自然推广到高维，为拓扑与临界性交叉领域提供基于对偶的判据，并启发在更多模型和平台上寻找此类对称富集临界性。

title: A high-speed, large-aperture 3D printed laser shutter for cold atom experiments
abstract: Cold atom experiments require optical shutters with rapid and repeatable actuation. Existing solutions often involve high cost, limited aperture diameter and slow transitioning. We present a 3D-printable shutter design featuring a large aperture of 4.5 mm diameter, low-cost assembly, and robust performance. The device achieves switching times of $399\pm8~\mu$s with delays of $2.7\pm0.2$ ms for a fully illuminated aperture, with four different shutters demonstrating repeatable performance. We measure the shutter speed to be $7.0\pm0.1$ m/s. This approach offers an accessible, scalable solution for cold atom and other optical experiments requiring multiple shutters with precise light control and avoids the need to resize or precision-align a beam through an aperture.
summary:
1. 该工作设计并表征了一种面向冷原子实验的3D打印激光快门，孔径4.5 mm，采用低成本组装并在四台器件上验证重复性。
2. 其技术卖点是在全孔径照明下实现399±8 μs开关时间、2.7±0.2 ms延迟和7.0±0.1 m/s遮光速度，且无需对光束进行缩束或精密穿孔对准。
3. 这为需要多快门精确光控的冷原子及其他光学实验提供了一种可扩展、易获取的方案，并降低了大口径快门的成本与对准门槛。

title: Non-uniform grids to accelerate electron-phonon coupling calculations for superconductivity
abstract: Efficient and accurate evaluation of electron-phonon interactions is essential for predictive superconductivity calculations, but dense Brillouin zone sampling requirements pose a major computational bottleneck. To overcome this, we introduce an accelerated, highly scalable framework that combines a double delta truncation scheme with non-uniform Farey grids in both $\mathbf{k}$ and $\mathbf{q}$ space. The truncation strategy significantly reduces computational cost by restricting integration to states satisfying energy constraints near the Fermi level, while the Farey grids dynamically resolve sampling errors from localized scattering and stabilize convergence. Applied to elemental aluminium and several high-pressure hydrides, this combined methodology reduces computational cost by up to two orders of magnitude and yields electron-phonon coupling constants and superconducting critical temperatures Tc typically within about 5% of full-grid benchmarks. This approach overcomes sampling bottlenecks associated with dense uniform grids, making accurate, low-cost predictions of superconductivity in complex quantum materials feasible.
summary:
1. 该工作提出并实现了一个可扩展的电声耦合计算加速框架，将双δ截断与非均匀Farey网格同时用于k和q空间，以减少超导性预测中的布里渊区密集采样成本。
2. 其技术核心在于用能量约束截断把积分限制在费米面附近，并借助Farey网格动态分辨局域散射引起的采样误差以稳定收敛；在元素铝和多种高压氢化物上，计算成本最多降低两个数量级，而电声耦合常数和Tc通常与全网格基准相差约5%以内。
3. 这为以非均匀采样替代密集均匀网格、在复杂量子材料中实现低成本且较准确的超导Tc预测提供了可推广的数值路径。

title: Good-$Γ$ Numbers: A Shell-Optimized Route to the Thermodynamic Limit in Quantum Monte Carlo Calculations of the High-Density Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
abstract: Single-particle finite-size errors remain a central obstacle in quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations of periodic systems, conventionally reduced via twist averaging (TA). Here we introduce Good-$\Gamma$ (GG) particle numbers as system sizes $N$ at which the $\Gamma$-point Hartree--Fock (HF) energy of the high-density two-dimensional uniform electron gas (2D UEG) lies anomalously close to its thermodynamic-limit (TL) value. All results in this work concern the 2D UEG in its high-density Fermi-liquid regime, $r_s=1$--$4$. We systematically investigate the kinetic- and exchange-energy errors, $\Delta KE(N)$ and $\Delta EX(N)$, that underlie this one-body finite-size-error cancellation across four densities and both spin polarizations. We then compare diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) energies extrapolated to the TL from GG-$N$ sequences against twist-averaged extrapolations at the same densities and polarizations, finding agreement to within a fraction of a millihartree in every case, independent of whether a $1/N$ or an $N^{-5/4}$ extrapolation form is used.
summary:
1. 该工作针对高密度二维均匀电子气（r_s=1–4）提出Good-Γ粒子数，即Γ点哈特里–福克能量异常接近热力学极限的体系尺寸，并系统分析其动能与交换能有限尺寸误差。
2. 其卖点在于利用这一单粒子误差抵消构造GG-N序列，使扩散蒙特卡洛外推与扭转平均外推在同密度、同自旋极化下仅差不到一毫哈特里，且对1/N与N^{-5/4}外推形式不敏感。
3. 这为周期体系量子蒙特卡洛提供了免于常规扭转平均的尺寸选择思路，但其在更宽参数区间及不同体系中的普适性仍需检验。

title: Spin fluctuations and nearly isotropic quasiparticles in the doped three-dimensional Hubbard model
abstract: Away from half filling and above its Neel temperature, the three-dimensional Hubbard model is a paramagnetic metal with antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations, where controlled momentum-resolved results have been lacking. Using connected-determinant diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we compute the momentum-resolved self-energy for n = 0.4-0.95, T/t = 0.05-0.33 and U/t = 4-8, and the full-zone spin susceptibility at twelve of these points, focusing on U/t = 4. At U/t = 4 and toward half filling the spin fluctuations become strong: for n = 0.7-0.9 at T/t = 0.14 they enhance the susceptibility peak up to sevenfold and raise the momentum-dependent part of the scattering rate to four to five times its second-order value. They are driven by an effective spin interaction screened to about 2U/3 and nearly uniform over the zone. Yet the peak height is set by the slightly smaller value of this interaction at the peak wave vector, and near magnetic order this small difference changes the height by a large factor. Two-particle self-consistent theory reproduces the peak because its sum rule fixes its single constant interaction near this value, but for n = 0.7-0.9 at T/t = 0.14 its self-energy overestimates the local scattering rate and underestimates the momentum-dependent part. Though strong, the fluctuations are short ranged, with a correlation length of at most about two lattice spacings, and for n = 0.7-0.9 and T/t >= 0.14 the scattering rate near the Fermi surface varies by at most about 1% at fixed band energy, without hot spots. At U/t = 4 dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) reproduces the local scattering rate and quasiparticle weight within a few percent, and the nonlocal part it misses is approximately a function of the band energy. Strong spin fluctuations thus coexist with nearly isotropic quasiparticles, and the results provide a benchmark for extensions of DMFT and for spin-fluctuation theories.
summary:
1. 该工作用连通行列式图蒙特卡洛计算了掺杂三维哈伯德模型在 n=0.4–0.95、T/t=0.05–0.33、U/t=4–8 的动量分辨自能，并在其中十二个参数点（重点 U/t=4）给出全布里渊区自旋磁化率。
2. 其核心结果是：靠近半满时反铁磁自旋涨落显著增强但短程（关联长度至多约两个格点），有效自旋相互作用约被屏蔽到 2U/3 且近乎均匀，而费米面附近散射率在固定带能下仅变化约1%、无明显热点，呈现近各向同性准粒子。
3. 这为扩展 DMFT 和自旋涨落理论提供了基准，并表明强自旋涨落可以与近各向同性准粒子共存。

title: Emergent Active-Blob Length Scale Governs the Collapse Transition of Tangentially Driven Polymers
abstract: The coil-to-globule transition is a paradigmatic phenomenon in polymer physics and biophysics, in which polymer chains evolve from swollen to globular conformations upon decreasing solvent quality. At equilibrium, this transition can be rationalized in terms of a thermal blob length that diverges at the so-called $\Theta$ condition, marking the crossover from self-avoiding to globular conformations. How activity modifies this conformational transition and affects the fundamental length scales at play remains poorly understood. Here, we address this question for tangentially driven polymers using Brownian dynamics simulations, systematically varying both intrachain attraction strength and activity. We find that polar activity smears out the crossover from swollen to globular conformations. Between self-avoiding and $\Theta$ conditions, activity dominates by introducing an emergent folding length scale, which acts as an active blob length. In this regime, we demonstrate that the ratio of thermal to active length scales provides a new scaling variable that leads to a universal master curve for active polymer collapse.
summary:
1. 该文用布朗动力学模拟系统调节链内吸引强度与切向驱动力，研究活性聚合物从溶胀线团到球状体的塌缩转变。
2. 其核心在于发现极性活性会抹平自避与Θ条件之间的转变，并引入由活性主导的折叠长度尺度，即“活性斑块”长度，且热长度与活性长度之比构成新的标度变量并可归并出普适主曲线。
3. 这一结果将平衡态热斑块图像推广到活性聚合物塌缩，为刻画活性驱动的构象转变与长度尺度竞争提供了可检验的标度框架。

title: Accelerating real-time hybrid-functional calculations with learned ACE and symmetry-based FFT reuse
abstract: Real-time hybrid-functional calculations require repeated reconstruction of nonlocal exchange, whose cost grows rapidly with Brillouin-zone sampling. We develop two methods to improve the efficiency of time evolution and spatial processing. The first learns the time evolution of adaptively compressed exchange (ACE) factors and predicts their updates, reducing the frequency of explicit reconstruction. The second uses crystal symmetry to reuse exchange fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) among equivalent real-space points. This symmetry-based FFT reuse (SBFR) reduces the number of FFTs while retaining the full $\bm k$-point sum. The methods can be used with a variety of hybrid functionals, and we use HSE06 in this work. Relative to an ACE reference using full-row mesh FFTs, learned prediction provides more than fivefold acceleration, SBFR more than fourteenfold, and their combination more than sixty-threefold. The combined method shows efficient parallel scaling. After learning, propagation takes less than 0.5 s per step. The reduced computational cost allows us to study nonlinear and nonequilibrium electron dynamics with hybrid functionals and to examine the role of excitonic effects in semiconductors and insulators.
summary:
1. 该工作针对实时杂化泛函计算中非局域交换反复重构开销随布里渊区采样快速增长的问题，提出学习自适应压缩交换因子时间演化与基于晶体对称性复用交换FFT两种加速方法，并在HSE06上验证。
2. 其卖点在于以学习预测减少ACE因子的显式重构频率，并利用等价实空间点复用FFT同时保留完整k点求和；相对全行网格FFT的ACE参考，学习预测、SBFR及二者结合分别加速逾5倍、14倍和63倍，单步传播低于0.5秒且并行扩展良好。
3. 这使杂化泛函研究非线性与非平衡电子动力学成为可行，并为考察半导体和绝缘体中的激子效应提供可扩展的计算路径。

title: A Transport-Information Framework for Continuous-Fiber-Aligned Coarse-Graining Representation Sets
abstract: Consider representation sets of interest whose elements are associated with continuous realizations related to them through coarse-graining (CG). CG can be regarded as an operation that reduces a representation by discarding information that is not retained in its output. However, a systematic description of the information structure associated with CG in general remains to be established. Here, we propose a transport-information framework for continuous-fiber-aligned representation sets, in which each representation is associated with a continuous realization through a fiber structure, with CG defining the projection onto the representation. Within this framework, CG is described through a local-map operation that transports continuous probability mass onto representative points. The resulting transport cost is expressed as the contraction of the second-moment structure of the underlying continuous representation with the transport metric. Building on the previously proposed framework of unavoidable canonical nonlinearity (UCN), this construction provides a non-arbitrary information-theoretic interpretation of the CG-associated transport cost in terms of information indistinguishability, quantified by an expected Kullback-Leibler divergence associated with the CG geometry. The present framework provides a basis for describing information costs associated with individual CG operations and for comparing representation sets while accounting for their underlying continuous realizations.
summary:
1. 该工作针对连续纤维对齐的粗粒化表示集，提出一个输运—信息框架，将每个表示经纤维结构与连续实现关联，并把粗粒化定义为到表示的投影。
2. 其核心是把粗粒化刻画为将连续概率质量输运到代表点的局部映射，输运代价由连续表示的二阶矩结构与输运度量的收缩给出，并借助UCN框架用期望KL散度赋予其信息不可区分性的非任意解释。
3. 这为描述单次粗粒化操作的信息成本、并在计入底层连续实现的前提下比较不同表示集提供了可操作基础。

title: Early-stage local melting during solid-state sintering of a Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf alloy: A combined thermodynamic and kinetic analysis
abstract: Complex concentrated alloys (CCAs) combining elements from 3d transition and refractory groups, specifically Cu-Ni-Ti-Zr-Hf-based shape memory systems, exhibit excellent functional properties but present significant manufacturing challenges via powder metallurgy. In this study, a non-equimolar Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5 (at. %) alloy was successfully produced by induction melting, followed by atomization and subsequent consolidation via Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS) at temperatures ranging from 850 to 1100 C. Although global equilibrium phase diagrams predict solid-state stability up to 1260 C, localized melting unexpectedly occurred during SPS at 1100 C. By combining retrospective Scheil-Gulliver solidification simulations with 2D local equilibrium heat maps, we demonstrate that this early-stage melting is not driven by macroscopic thermal gradients, but by microsegregation inherited from atomization. During solid-state heating, thermally activated short-range diffusion, accelerated by high defect densities at particle interfaces, partitions Ti towards the interparticle network, leaving Cu-enriched regions (up to ~41 at. %) within the particle interiors. Owing to the strongly negative mixing enthalpy of Cu with Hf (-19.2 kJ/mol for $\Delta H_{mix}^{l-l}$) and, to a lesser extent, with Ti, the local solidus of these Cu-rich regions is dramatically depressed. Upon heating to 1100 C, these regions cross their local solidus and form a liquid phase, whose solidification produces the Cu-Hf co-segregation. This framework accounts for localized melting phenomena in rapidly solidified CCA powders containing low-melting constituents with strong negative mixing enthalpies.
summary:
1. 该工作经感应熔炼与气雾化制备非等原子Cu15Ni35Ti25Zr12.5Hf12.5复杂浓缩合金，在放电等离子烧结850–1100 °C时发现1100 °C局部熔化，并用热力学-动力学分析解释。
2. 其卖点在于结合回溯Scheil-Gulliver凝固模拟与二维局域平衡热图，证明熔化由气雾化继承的微观偏析而非宏观热梯度驱动：界面高缺陷加速短程扩散使Ti向颗粒间网络分配、颗粒内Cu富集至约41 at.%，Cu-Hf（及较弱Cu-Ti）强负混合焓显著压低局域固相线。
3. 该框架可解释含低熔点组元且具强负混合焓的快速凝固复杂浓缩合金粉末的固相烧结局域熔化，并为粉末冶金工艺窗口设计提供依据。

title: Classical-to-Quantum Transition in Blackbody Radiation Thermodynamics: Planck's Law without Statistical Assumptions
abstract: Inspired by Fermi's model of radiation-matter interaction, we investigate the classical dynamics of a closed, finite-energy system, in which matter is coupled to an electromagnetic field. We find that energy is progressively transferred to increasingly high-frequency field modes, so that the effective temperature of both matter and radiation approaches zero in the long-time limit - in sharp contradiction with the finite-temperature equilibrium assumed by classical blackbody thermodynamics. Requiring consistency with the Stefan-Boltzmann and Wien laws identifies a characteristic time $t_L$, at which both laws are simultaneously satisfied. Strikingly, classical spectra obtained for different energies and cavity sizes collapse onto the universal Planck distribution at $t_L$. We conjecture that quantum dynamical localization arrests the classical energy cascade at $t_L$, and that the Planck distribution emerges as a dynamical consequence of this arrest - without invoking any a priori statistical assumption.
summary:
1. 该文在有限能量的闭合物质-电磁场耦合系统中用经典动力学追踪辐射热力学演化，并考察其与普朗克黑体谱的关系。
2. 关键点是经典能量级联向高频模式转移使有效温度趋于零，而在同时满足斯特藩-玻尔兹曼与维恩定律的特征时刻 t_L，不同能量和腔尺寸的经典谱坍缩为普朗克分布。
3. 作者据此猜想量子动力学局域化在 t_L 截断级联，使普朗克分布成为动力学结果而非先验统计假设，为黑体辐射的经典-量子过渡提供可检验思路。

title: Thermodynamic Stability of Classical $\mathbb Z_2$ Lattice Gauge Models
abstract: Finite-temperature phases are traditionally studied through spontaneous symmetry breaking, but symmetry-breaking fields can remove their distinction, as in the Ising model. This motivates the search for stable nontrivial thermal phases without symmetry protection. For classical $\mathbb Z_2$ lattice gauge models with spins on $m$-dimensional cells in a fixed spatial dimension $d$, we prove joint analyticity of the thermodynamic free-energy density in temperature and perturbation strength at sufficiently low positive temperatures under sufficiently weak local perturbations, whenever $1\le m\le d-2$. Perturbations need not preserve internal or gauge symmetries and may include noncommuting quantum interactions. A separate high-temperature expansion yields an analytic region reaching infinite temperature at any fixed finite perturbation strength. These results establish thermodynamic stability and support the conjecture that low- and high-temperature regimes remain separated by a thermal transition without symmetry protection.
summary:
1. 该工作针对固定空间维度d中置于m维胞腔上的经典Z₂格点规范模型（1≤m≤d−2），证明了在足够低的正温度与足够弱的局域微扰下，热力学自由能密度对温度和微扰强度联合解析。
2. 其关键卖点在于微扰无需保持内部或规范对称性且可含非对易量子相互作用，同时独立的高温展开给出在任意固定有限微扰强度下可延伸至无穷温度的另一解析区域。
3. 这些结果确立了无对称保护下的热力学稳定性，并为低温与高温区域之间仍由热相变分隔的猜想提供了支持。

title: Effect of interfacial water structure on the adsorption of weakly hydrated anions
abstract: Weakly hydrated anions tend to partition to macromolecular surfaces, leading to salting-in at low salt concentrations. Recent studies have linked this partitioning to disruption of the interfacial water network. Here, we investigate the role of interfacial-water-network disruption as an indirect driving force for the adsorption of weakly hydrated anions and its interplay with direct solute-anion and anion-cation interactions using computer simulations. We study the adsorption of SCN$^{-}$ and I$^{-}$ ions on a model extended solute that interacts with water and ions only via van der Waals interactions. To probe the indirect contribution, we increase the effective solute size while simultaneously decreasing the attractive solute-water and solute-ion interactions, resulting in progressively greater disorder in the interfacial water network in pure aqueous solutions. Our results show that iodide adsorption increases despite weaker direct solute-iodide interactions and correlates with greater disruption of the interfacial water network, although iodide remains depleted overall. In contrast, preferential adsorption of SCN$^{-}$ decreases, but the rate of decrease becomes smaller at higher levels of interfacial-water-network disorder. This suggests that the indirect contribution associated with interfacial-water-network disruption partly compensates for the decrease in SCN$^{-}$ adsorption caused by weaker direct solute-SCN$^{-}$ interactions. Our results highlight that the indirect contribution associated with interfacial-water-network disruption promotes the adsorption of weakly hydrated anions on macromolecular surfaces, while the extent of adsorption also depends on direct solute-ion interactions and anion-cation pairing. This interplay may be particularly important in mixed-salt solutions, where the presence of strongly hydrated anions can also disrupt the interfacial water network.
summary:
1. 该工作用计算机模拟在仅范德华相互作用的模型扩展溶质上研究SCN−和I−吸附，通过增大溶质尺寸并减弱溶质-水及溶质-离子吸引来系统增加界面水网络无序度，以辨析界面水网络破坏作为弱水化阴离子吸附间接驱动力的作用及其与直接相互作用和离子配对的耦合。
2. 其卖点是：碘化物总体仍贫化，但吸附随界面水网络破坏增强而增加，尽管直接溶质-碘相互作用减弱；SCN−优先吸附随无序度增加而下降，但降幅变小，表明间接贡献可部分补偿直接作用减弱。
3. 这表明界面水网络破坏会促进弱水化阴离子在大分子表面的吸附，但吸附程度仍受直接溶质-离子作用和阴离子-阳离子配对调控，在强水化阴离子共存的混合盐体系中尤需考虑。

title: Generalized Spin Groups and Applications to Magnons
abstract: Spin groups provide the natural symmetry framework for the isotropic Heisenberg model, in which spin and lattice degrees of freedom are separable. They have recently found broad applications in describing electronic band structure, magnon band topology, and transport phenomena. However, a typical spin Hamiltonian describing magnons contains not only isotropic Heisenberg exchange but also anisotropic interactions induced by spin-orbit coupling (SOC), including the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, the Gamma exchange, and the single-ion anisotropy (SIA), which strongly influence magnon properties. More recently, some studies have also revealed relativistic magnon transport phenomena in altermagnets. Such systems typically exhibit partial spin-lattice locking, but are commonly assumed to be described by conventional magnetic groups. Here, we develop a systematic symmetry framework, generalized spin groups, for magnons. We first classify the symmetries of Heisenberg, DM, Gamma, and SIA interactions. The resulting classification contains 6 spin-only groups, together with a total of 161 nontrivial spin groups. The symmetries of magnetically ordered phases are then obtained through spontaneous symmetry breaking of the corresponding parent groups for spin Hamiltonians. We also identify 6 spin-only groups for ordered states, which generate 90, 264, 157, 264, 387, and 598 nontrivial spin groups, respectively. Finally, we apply generalized spin groups to the magnon thermal conductivity and spin conductivity tensors and derive all the symmetry-allowed forms. Our results provide a unified symmetry framework for analyzing magnon transport both with and without SOC, yielding more refined constraints on magnon responses.
summary:
1. 该工作建立了面向磁振子的广义自旋群对称框架，系统分类Heisenberg、DM、Gamma与单离子各向异性相互作用及磁有序相，并应用于热导率与自旋导率张量。
2. 其核心在于把SOC诱导的各向异性交换与部分自旋-晶格锁定纳入统一自旋群，得到6个纯自旋群和161个非平凡自旋群，并给出有序相经母群自发破缺生成的多组非平凡自旋群及全部对称允许的输运张量形式。
3. 这为有无SOC的磁振子输运提供比常规磁群更精细的对称约束，并可启发交错磁体等部分自旋-晶格锁定体系中磁振子响应分析。

title: Polarity-selective domain wall propagation driven by spin-orbit torque
abstract: Spatial variations in magnetic anisotropy impede the spin-orbit-torque-driven motion of chiral domain walls in perpendicularly magnetized nanowires. We show that the local geometry of a two-dimensional anisotropy landscape can select which wall polarity propagates under a given current. Micromagnetic simulations of spatially correlated random anisotropy landscapes generated by diffusion-based smoothing reveal different propagation outcomes for up--down and down--up walls within the same disorder realization. A single inclined anisotropy boundary isolates the mechanism: in the presence of the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, opposite wall polarities develop opposite current-induced tilts, producing different alignment with the boundary and hence different pinning strengths. Reversing the boundary inclination interchanges the pinned and propagating polarities. An extended collective-coordinate model captures this geometric selection and distinguishes the propagation threshold from the static pinning limit.
summary:
1. 该工作通过微磁模拟研究自旋轨道力矩驱动的手性畴壁在垂直磁化纳米线中受二维空间关联随机各向异性影响时的传播，发现局部各向异性几何可在同一无序实现中筛选出特定电流下能够传播的畴壁极性。
2. 其核心机制是手性反对称交换相互作用使相反极性畴壁产生相反的电流诱导倾斜，从而与倾斜各向异性边界形成不同取向匹配和不同钉扎强度，翻转边界倾角即可交换被钉扎与可传播的极性。
3. 扩展的集体坐标模型能够刻画这种几何选择并区分传播阈值与静态钉扎极限，为无序磁各向异性环境中的畴壁操控与器件设计提供了可检验的物理判据。

title: Time-Reversal Symmetry in Artificial Topological Graphene Rings
abstract: We study an artificial graphene ring described by the low-energy two-valley Dirac Hamiltonian with a uniform mass term. When the ring is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux, the problem reduces to a second-order radial equation solved by Bessel functions. We give the exact secular equation and, for narrow rings, closed expressions for the spectrum and the persistent current. We then add a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the plane. The radial problem is solved with confluent hypergeometric functions, and the persistent current and magnetization are written as derivatives of a secular determinant from which the spurious roots have been removed. Besides the usual orbital coupling, the field enters through a valley-dependent term that comes from the Dirac structure and lifts the valley degeneracy. A weak-field expansion, accurate up to corrections of order B^4, gives this valley splitting explicitly and separates the diamagnetic and paramagnetic contributions to the susceptibility. Finally, we work out what time reversal implies for the spectrum. Physical time reversal, which exchanges the valleys, leads to an exact relation between levels at opposite fields. The effective single-valley time reversal, on the other hand, is broken by the mass term and by the boundary conditions, yet leaves no trace in the zero-field spectrum. Numerical results for the spectrum, the persistent current, and the magnetization illustrate the analysis.
summary:
1. 该工作研究了由双谷低能狄拉克哈密顿量与均匀质量项描述的人工石墨烯环，在Aharonov-Bohm通量和垂直磁场下求解径向方程，给出谱、持续电流与磁化的精确及窄环解析结果。
2. 其技术要点是用贝塞尔/合流超几何函数与剔除伪根的久期行列式处理轨道耦合和狄拉克结构导致的谷依赖项，显式给出弱场至B^4的谷分裂，并分离磁化率的抗磁与顺磁贡献。
3. 该分析为人工石墨烯环中的谷简并、持续电流和磁化提供了定量基准，并表明单谷有效时间反演虽被质量项和边界条件破坏，却在零场谱中不留痕迹。

title: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
abstract: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across $\nu=1/5$, $1/3$, and $2/5$, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.
summary:
1. 该工作在球几何下分析神经网络分数量子霍尔态中物理先验与网络灵活性的权衡，并提出轨道对矩阵因子MHPO-M拟设，在ν=1/5、1/3与2/5处进行变分检验。
2. 其关键在于以依赖电子构型与轨道的可学习配对因子替代固定Laughlin结构，避免刚性通量附着限制表达能力，同时在测试变体中获得最低变分能量，并借助因子化轨道读出扩展至35个电子。
3. 这表明物理先验可在不牺牲神经网络波函数灵活性的前提下恰当嵌入，为包含朗道能级混合的可扩展、精确FQH建模提供了可行路径。

title: Field theories and critical excitations at anyon condensation transitions
abstract: Anyon condensation transitions remain challenging to characterize especially when the condensing anyons are non-abelian. We develop two complementary approaches for extracting information about the transition from the categorical data of the parent topological order and the condensate. The first adapts a Ginzburg-Landau procedure developed for $1+1$D transitions in the SymTFT setting to $2+1$D anyon condensation transitions. The construction applies when the anyons participating in the condensate have integer quantum dimensions. The second gives a criterion for identifying which point and loop excitations become critical at a continuous transition. The key step is to determine which anyon loops remain condensed throughout. All other loops become critical, while a point excitation becomes critical if it braids trivially with every condensed loop. We illustrate both proposals in several abelian and non-abelian examples.
summary:
1. 该工作针对非阿贝尔任意子凝聚相变难以刻画的问题，提出两套互补方法，从母拓扑序与凝聚体的范畴数据中提取相变信息。
2. 其一将SymTFT框架下1+1维相变的Ginzburg-Landau构造推广到2+1维，并适用于凝聚任意子具有整数量子维度的情形；其二以始终保持凝聚的任意子环为关键判据，确定其余环及与所有凝聚环平凡编织的点激发成为连续相变中的临界激发。
3. 该框架为仅凭范畴数据刻画任意子凝聚连续相变及临界激发提供了可操作路径，并在阿贝尔与非阿贝尔示例中得到说明。

title: Enhancement of Li and Na Storage in Janus HfSSe Monolayers by Co-Induced Electron-Deficient Chalcogen Sites: A First-Principles Study
abstract: The growing demand for high-capacity, fast-charging, and durable rechargeable batteries has intensified the search for advanced electrode materials, with two-dimensional materials offering large surface-to-mass ratios and short ion-diffusion pathways. Here, pristine and Co-doped Janus HfSSe monolayers were investigated as anode materials for Li-ion and Na-ion batteries using first-principles density functional theory. Pristine HfSSe was found to be dynamically stable and exhibited a 0.85 eV band gap, while Co substitution shifted the Fermi level toward the valence-band region. Adsorption of the first Li or Na layer induced metallic behavior, thereby improving charge transport. Co doping strengthened alkali-metal binding, with the most favorable Li and Na adsorption energies changing from -2.6125 and -1.9800 eV to -3.7405 and -3.0529 eV, respectively. Co doping created electron-deficient sites that enhanced Li/Na binding. Co-doped HfSSe accommodated up to four Li layers and three Na layers, increasing the theoretical capacities from 555.43 to 776.19 mAh/g for Li and from 370.29 to 582.14 mAh/g for Na. The average open-circuit voltages were 0.62 V for Li and 0.29-0.30 V for Na, with minimum migration barriers of 0.2153 and 0.1044 eV, respectively. These results identified Co-doped Janus HfSSe as a promising anode material for Li-ion and Na-ion batteries.
summary:
1. 该工作用第一性原理密度泛函理论系统研究了本征与Co掺杂Janus HfSSe单层作为锂离子和钠离子电池负极的吸附、电子结构与离子输运性质。
2. 其核心卖点在于Co替位引入缺电子硫族位点，使Li/Na最有利吸附能从-2.6125/-1.9800 eV增强至-3.7405/-3.0529 eV，首层吸附诱导金属性改善电荷输运，并分别将理论容量由555.43/370.29 mAh/g提升至776.19/582.14 mAh/g（Li可容四层、Na三层）。
3. 该结果给出了一条以缺电子位点调控二维Janus负极碱金属结合的思路，其0.2153与0.1044 eV的最低迁移势垒及0.62 V（Li）、0.29–0.30 V（Na）的平均开路电压，为后续快充负极设计与实验验证提供了可检验的依据。

title: Finite-size spin fluctuations and fixed-index sweeps in a ferromagnetic spinor condensate
abstract: We find a dip in the optimized rotation quantum Fisher information of a zero-magnetization ferromagnetic spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate near the excited-state quantum phase transition. Its displacement from $\epsilon_c=-q$ decreases on an inverse-size scale. At $q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2$, the dip value of $F_{\max}$ equals $2\langle S^2\rangle$ for $N$ up to $3840$, linking it to total-spin fluctuations. A semiclassical orbit average normalized by the classical density of states describes the dip over $N=120$--$3840$ with maximum relative residual below $0.028$; a small power law fits comparably. Inserting the measured energy offsets directly into the semiclassical formula leaves residuals of $17$--$30\%$, so $\kappa$ acts as an effective cutoff. Among retained states, spin-nematic squeezing occurs at the spectral edges. Separately, fixed-index excited-state sweeps have half-excitation times between $11.2$ and $13.1$ times their ground-state counterparts, with local size exponents increasing across the four sizes.
summary:
1. 该文研究零磁化铁磁自旋-1玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚中优化转动量子Fisher信息在激发态量子相变附近的凹陷，并分析固定指标激发态扫描的激发时间。
2. 其卖点在于凹陷值Fmax在N≤3840时等于总自旋涨落2⟨S^2⟩，且按经典态密度归一化的半经典轨道平均能以低于0.028的最大相对残差描述N=120–3840的凹陷，同时κ表现为有效截断、谱边缘存在自旋-向列压缩。
3. 固定指标扫描的半激发时间为基态的11.2–13.1倍且局域尺寸指数随四个尺寸增大，这为利用有限尺寸自旋涨落诊断激发态临界性及设计扫描协议提供了启示。

title: Proliferation Transitions for Quantum Doubles of Groups
abstract: Proliferation transitions are phase transitions between a 2+1d topological order $\mathcal{T}$ and another $\mathcal{T}/\mathcal{A}$, obtained by condensing anyons in an algebra $\mathcal{A}\subset \mathcal{T}$. We consider such transitions in quantum doubles of groups, $\mathcal{T}=D(G, \omega)$, for finite groups $G$ possibly with three-cocycle $\omega$, for which condensable algebras are fully classified. Given a condensable algebra $\mathcal{A}$, we represent $\mathcal{T}$ in terms of a Symmetry Topological Field Theory (SymTFT), that is tailored to the $\mathcal{A}$ proliferation transition. The SymTFT bulk is constructed from the Müger center of the subcategory generated by the algebra, i.e. the category of transparent lines, which can be bosons or fermions. Properties of the transition can then be inferred directly from the algebra classification data. For gauged Landau-Ginzburg (LG*) type transitions, we show that they do not only depend on the anyons in $\mathcal{A}$ through their field content, but the cubic interactions are fixed in terms of the multiplication structure of $\mathcal{A}$. Applied to twin algebras, which have the same anyon content but different multiplication structures, we show that twins result in distinct proliferation transitions.
summary:
1. 该工作系统研究了有限群量子双重 D(G,ω) 中由任意子凝聚代数 A 诱导的增殖相变，并借助可凝聚代数的完整分类给出统一处理。
2. 其核心是用针对 A 定制的 SymTFT 表示 T，并以代数生成子范畴的 Müger 中心（透明线可为玻色子或费米子）构造体，从而由代数分类数据直接读出相变性质；对 gauged LG* 型相变，三次相互作用由 A 的乘法结构固定，因而任意子内容相同的 twin 代数可给出不同相变。
3. 这为从凝聚代数与乘法结构分类任意子凝聚相变、区分同任意子内容的 twin 模型及理解 gauged LG* 转变提供了可推广的代数框架。

title: Dynamics of two bosons with density-assisted tunnelling in a one-dimensional tilted lattice
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of two bosons in a tilted one-dimensional optical lattice with both standard and density-assisted tunnelling. The relative sign of the two tunnelling processes strongly affects the Bloch dynamics, leading to distinct reinforcing and competing regimes. We examine how the tunnelling processes generate correlations and find that, in the absence of onsite interactions, the early-time entanglement growth follows the same scaling with the density-assisted tunnelling amplitude. Finite onsite interaction changes this picture by breaking the symmetry between the reinforcing and competing regimes and enhancing the correlation differently in two regimes. This shows how the interplay between the two tunnelling mechanisms can change dyanmics and entanglement in a controlled few-body setting. Particularly, at equal tunnelling amplitudes, the doublon and singlon sectors decouple completely for arbitrary onsite interaction, lattice tilting, and initial state.
summary:
1. 该工作研究了倾斜一维光晶格中同时含标准隧穿与密度辅助隧穿时两个玻色子的动力学与关联生成。
2. 核心卖点是两种隧穿相对符号可切换增强与竞争机制，无相互作用时早期纠缠增长按密度辅助隧穿幅度同标度，有限相互作用则非对称增强关联，且在等幅度下双占位与单占位子扇区对任意相互作用、倾斜和初态完全解耦。
3. 这为在可控少体光晶格体系中利用隧穿机制调控布洛赫动力学、关联与纠缠提供了明确切入点。

title: Classical spin liquids in the kagome Ising model, and their link with magnetoelasticity
abstract: We investigate a nearest-neighbor Ising model on the kagome lattice coupled to elastic lattice distortions. By integrating out the lattice degrees of freedom, we derive an approximate spin-only description in terms of a kagome \(J_1\)-\(J_2\)-\(J_{3}\) Ising model with interactions extending to third nearest-neighbors. Using tensor network methods complemented by classical Monte Carlo simulations, we revisit its zero-temperature phase diagram and characterize the ground states studied more than thirty years ago. We discover three phases with extensive zero-temperature entropy and algebraically decaying spin correlations. Importantly, these states are not confined to fine-tuned points or frontiers between phases, but occupy extended areas of parameter space. Their quasi long-range order is reflected in Bragg-like peaks in the structure factors; we relate this, and other properties, to diverse phases found in Ising and Heisenberg models. Finally, we trace the trajectories generated by the magnetoelastic coupling through the effective-model phase diagram, explaining the emergence of self-frustration for the unfrustrated magnetoelastic model with ferromagnetic interactions.
summary:
1. 该工作将kagome晶格最近邻Ising模型与弹性畸变耦合，通过积分掉晶格自由度得到含至第三近邻的J1-J2-J3自旋等效模型，并用张量网络与经典蒙特卡洛重审零温相图及旧基态。
2. 其要点是在扩展参数区发现三个具有广延零温熵和代数衰减自旋关联的经典自旋液体相，且其准长程序表现为结构因子中的Bragg型峰，并厘清其与Ising/Heisenberg模型的联系。
3. 这通过追踪磁弹耦合在等效相图中的轨迹解释了无阻挫铁磁磁弹模型的自阻挫起源，并为经典自旋液体在可调晶格耦合平台中的实现与辨识提供启示。

title: Electronic driving of torsional modes in carbon nanotubes via orbital-phonon coupling
abstract: We theoretically investigate electronic driving of a torsional mode in a suspended carbon nanotube quantum dot. The valley states in a nanotube carry opposite orbital magnetic moments along the tube axis, and intervalley mixing forms valley-mixed eigenstates whose splitting can be controlled by an axial magnetic field. We formulate an orbital-rotation coupling between the torsional angular velocity and the valley orbital angular momentum. Using a master equation for sequential tunneling through normal-metal electrodes, we calculate the steady-state current and the phonon distribution of the torsional mode. When the valley-state splitting matches the torsional phonon energy, orbital transitions can drive the mode out of equilibrium. The contacts control both phonon pumping and its electrical readout, allowing substantial excitation with a positive, vanishing, or negative current response. The mechanism requires no intrinsic spin or valley polarization of the electrodes, but uses state-dependent tunneling at the contacts.
summary:
1. 该文理论研究了悬浮碳纳米管量子点中电子对扭转模式的驱动，建立扭转角速度与谷轨道角动量间的轨道-旋转耦合，并用顺序隧穿主方程计算稳态电流与扭转声子分布。
2. 其关键在于谷混合本征态的分裂可由轴向磁场调节，当该分裂与扭转声子能量共振时，轨道跃迁可将模式泵出平衡，且接触通过态依赖隧穿同时控制声子泵浦与电学读出，无需电极自旋或谷极化。
3. 该机制表明普通金属接触即可实现可调扭转声子激发及正、零、负电流响应，为纳米机电器件的电子驱动与读出提供可检验的理论路径。

title: Initial-State-Dictated Dynamical Universality Classes in Quantum Criticality
abstract: The concept of universality class lies at the core of phase transition physics, with each class uniquely characterized by a dedicated set of critical exponents. Here, we introduce the concept of initial-state-dictated dynamical universality classes in nonequilibrium quantum critical dynamics. By studying the imaginary-time relaxation dynamics of the dimerized Heisenberg model, we demonstrate that distinct kinds of initial states can give rise to different dynamical universality classes within the same equilibrium universality class. Specifically, we find that "classical'' paramagnetic (random-spin) and "quantum'' paramagnetic (dimerized and antidimerized) initial states yield drastically different critical initial slip exponents in the bulk. This initial-state dependence also extends to boundary critical dynamics, where different initial states yield different surface critical initial slip exponents even within the same boundary universality class. Remarkably, for the antidimerized initial state, we uncover an anomalous scaling law violating the conventional relation between the bulk and surface critical initial slip exponents. Our results establish an initial-state-controlled dynamical classification of quantum criticality that extends beyond the conventional equilibrium universality paradigm.
summary:
1. 该工作在二聚化海森堡模型的虚时弛豫动力学中提出并验证了由初始态决定的非平衡量子临界动力学普适类。
2. 其核心在于：同一平衡普适类内，经典顺磁随机自旋与量子顺磁二聚/反二聚初态给出显著不同的体临界初始滑移指数，并延伸至边界，且反二聚态出现违背常规体-面关系的反常标度。
3. 这表明量子临界动力学分类需纳入初始态信息，为超越平衡普适范式的非平衡临界现象及后续数值与实验研究提供了可检验框架。

title: Orbital-angular-momentum control of localized Floquet states and photocurrents in Weyl semimetals
abstract: Structured light provides a route to controlling quantum materials not only through its polarization, but also through its spatial profile and orbital angular momentum (OAM). We develop real space theories of a Weyl semimetal driven by a vortex beam and show that optical OAM generates highly localized Floquet vortex states with pronounced circulating photocurrents. Exploiting cylindrical symmetry, we derive a Bogoliubov-de Gennes-like radial equation that resolves the states by angular momentum and reveals their evolution between the light-dressed Weyl cones. For Laguerre-Gaussian beams, the spatially varying drive produces strong hybridization between localized vortex states and bulk states. We complement this continuum description with a Wilson-lattice formulation that retains the full two-dimensional spatial structure and enables direct calculation of local photocurrents. Both approaches consistently identify OAM-induced vortex states localized around the beam axis. The lattice calculation further shows that these states support substantially stronger circulating current densities than the more extended surface states, with the largest current densities associated with the most strongly localized, low-angular-momentum vortex modes. Our results establish optical OAM as a tunable control parameter for creating and manipulating localized current-carrying states in Weyl systems and provide a real-space framework for studying photocurrents generated by spatially structured light.
summary:
1. 该工作建立了涡旋光驱动外尔半金属的实空间理论，结合类Bogoliubov–de Gennes径向方程与Wilson晶格模型，研究光轨道角动量诱导的局域Floquet涡旋态及光电流。
2. 其核心在于利用柱对称按角动量分解光缀饰态，并在Laguerre-Gaussian光束下刻画局域涡旋态与体态杂化，同时在保留完整二维空间结构的晶格计算中直接给出局域光电流。
3. 结果表明OAM可作为调控局域载流态的可调参数，最局域的低角动量涡旋模具有最强环行电流密度，并为空间结构光驱动的光电流研究提供实空间框架。

title: Ubiquitous Flat Bands in Edge-Inflated Random Graphs
abstract: Flat bands are usually associated with periodic lattice geometries, where destructive interference or chiral-symmetry constraints produce macroscopically degenerate eigenstates. Here we show that flat bands arise generically in a broad class of nonperiodic random networks through a simple edge-inflation procedure. Starting from random regular, Voronoi tessellation, Delaunay triangulation, scale-free, small-world, and Erdös-Rényi seed graphs, each edge is replaced by a finite one-dimensional tight-binding chain, either with fixed length $L$ or with random lengths of mean $\bar L$. Although the original random graphs typically have adjacency matrices of full rank and therefore few or no zero eigenstates, their inflated counterparts exhibit extensive flat bands. The flat-band energies are determined by the eigenstates residing on the chains or, more generally, by the eigenvalues of identical loopless motifs replacing the seed bonds. The corresponding eigenstates are states supported on subsets of the inflated chains formed by destructive interference at the original seed vertices. For zero-energy flat bands, we relate the degeneracy to the graph nullity $\eta(G)$ and the maximum matching number $\nu(G)$. The numerical results support the correspondence $\eta(G)=N-2\nu(G)$, up to small deviations, across the random graph ensembles studied. The fraction of degenerate zero-energy states in inflated random graphs is controlled primarily by the average degree of the seed graph. We further show that the flat bands exhibit characteristic robustness to disorder: disorder on the seed sites and random magnetic flux leave the flat bands essentially unchanged, while bond disorder and disorder on the chain or motif sites broaden them. These results show that flat bands do not require crystalline order, but can emerge as robust consequences of local graph inflation and motif substitution.
summary:
1. 该工作将随机正则、Voronoi、Delaunay、无标度、小世界和Erdős–Rényi种子图的每条边替换为固定长度或随机平均长度的有限一维紧束缚链，证明平带可在广泛非周期随机网络中普适出现。
2. 其卖点是平带能量由链或替代种子键的无环基元本征态决定，零能简并联系图零度η(G)与最大匹配数ν(G)，简并态比例主要由种子图平均度控制，且对种子位点无序与随机磁通稳健而对键及链上位点无序展宽。
3. 这表明平带无需晶体序，可作为局部图膨胀与基元替换的稳健结果，为无序网络中的平带工程和简并态调控提供启发。

title: Sum-over-poles framework for quantum embedding to approach the real-frequency axis
abstract: We introduce a real-frequency framework for the quantum embedding of solids, based on sum-over-poles (SOP) representations. We partition the lattice into periodically repeated interacting fragments and derive an embedded Dyson equation for the fragment, to be solved self-consistently. The resulting scheme generalizes the algorithmic-inversion method of our previous work to interacting Hamiltonians and is closely related to dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), especially when an extended impurity problem is introduced. By exploiting the compact pole expansion of the embedding potential, we carry out the self-consistent procedure close to the real axis, which avoids ill-posed analytic continuation. In addition, the SOP representation allows us to introduce a pole-and-residue dynamics, which we use to reach the self-consistent solution. After deriving the method, we benchmark it against exact-diagonalization implementations of DMFT on the one-dimensional Hubbard ring at half filling. The framework offers a natural route to real-space dynamical quantum embedding, for periodic systems as well as for strongly correlated defects in materials.
summary:
1. 该工作提出了基于极点求和表示的固体量子嵌入实频率框架，将晶格划分为周期性重复的相互作用碎片，并推导出自洽求解的嵌入戴森方程。
2. 其核心在于用嵌入势的紧凑极点展开把自洽过程推进到实轴附近，从而避免病态解析延拓，并以极点-留数动力学获得自洽解，同时将先前的算法反演方法推广到相互作用哈密顿量并联系动力学平均场理论。
3. 该方法在半满一维哈伯德环上以动力学平均场理论的精确对角化实现为基准进行了检验，并为周期体系和材料中强关联缺陷的实空间动力学量子嵌入提供了自然路径。

title: Multiscale Modeling of Zr Corrosion: Predicting Microstructures of Oxide Films
abstract: A first-principles-informed multiscale modeling approach is reported for oxide formation during corrosion of zirconium. The present simulations reproduce the columnar corrosion film microstructure and grain size distribution seen in micrographs of oxidized Zr surfaces. This structural feature emerges from a hexagonal ZrO layer adjacent to the $\alpha$-Zr/ZrO$_{2-x}$ interface, which is dynamically stabilized by continuous heterogeneous grain nucleation and grain boundary mass diffusion. This ZrO layer is identified as a significant oxygen diffusion barrier and a potential contributor to sub-parabolic pretransition corrosion kinetics. The simulations also reproduce the undulatory nature of the metal/oxide interface, leading to regions with tensile stress components capable of nucleating cracks, despite the overall state of compressive hydrostatic stress within the oxide film. First principles density functional theory (DFT) computations of fundamental ZrO$_x$ properties were combined with molecular dynamics simulations using a machine-learned potential based on a DFT training set to provide extensive input to an advanced phase field model for oxide formation and its microstructure, as implemented in the new MedeA PhaseField module. The phase field simulations reported herein incorporated computed stoichiometry-dependent thermochemical data, anisotropic elastic properties, interface energies, bulk and grain boundary mass transport processes, multiphase heterogeneous grain nucleation, and strain energy-dependent phase stabilities.
summary:
1. 该工作建立第一性原理驱动的多尺度框架，将密度泛函理论、机器学习势分子动力学与相场模型耦合，预测锆腐蚀氧化膜的形成与微观结构。
2. 其卖点是相场模拟复现柱状氧化膜与晶粒尺寸分布，并揭示界面附近动态稳定的六方ZrO层由连续异质晶核和晶界扩散维持，可作为氧扩散势垒并解释亚抛物线预转变动力学，同时再现界面起伏与可萌生裂纹的局部拉应力。
3. 这为将原子尺度热化学、各向异性弹性、界面能和传质过程纳入氧化膜介观演化预测提供了可扩展路径，并提示界面结构与应力局域化是理解锆腐蚀动力学的关键。

title: Symmetry-Guided Machine Learning of Spin-Dependent Nonlinear Hall Response
abstract: A Berry-curvature dipole can produce a nonlinear Hall current even when the linear Hall response vanishes, but symmetry alone does not determine its magnitude or magnetic tunability. The interplay of structural symmetry, moment orientation, and carrier occupation is examined in a honeycomb model. Curvature maps and the band-summed dipole integrand reveal how velocity and the occupation window near the Fermi level select signed contributions. Removing threefold rotation permits a nonmagnetic dipole perpendicular to the surviving mirror. Generic magnetic reorientation activates the second component and tunes both components through positive and negative values. Global reversal preserves the dipole while reversing the intrinsic linear Hall conductivity, allowing a finite bulk dipole contribution from equally populated reversed domains under uniform-field averaging.A symmetry-constrained polynomial model predicts both dipole components for 256 held-out spin configurations, achieving coefficients of determination $R^2 > 0.9995$ at the reference chemical potential. At fixed carrier density, orientation-dependent shifts of the chemical potential modify the response and yield slightly larger prediction errors for the chosen model.
