Across the chemical-potential sweep,the prediction accuracy decreases more strongly for $D_y$,revealing an energy dependence of the surrogate's performance. Within semiclassical transport with a constant relaxation time, the calculated dipole determines the angular dependence of the quadratic current and its rectified and second-harmonic components. These results provide a quantitative representation of magnetic-orientation-dependent Berry-curvature dipoles and show how carrier occupation influences both the response and its predictability.
summary:
1. 该工作在蜂窝模型中结合对称性分析与机器学习，研究自旋依赖的贝里曲率偶极和非线性霍尔响应。
2. 其卖点是采用对称约束多项式预测偶极两个分量，在参考化学势下对256个留出自旋构型决定系数超过0.9995。
3. 这为磁取向相关偶极提供了定量表征，并表明载流子占据会同时影响非线性响应与机器学习预测精度。

title: An Algebraic Formulation of Thermality in Nested Rindler Wedges
abstract: Padmanabhan and Kolekar had demonstrated the phenomenon of recursive thermality in two dimensional free field theories where the Rindler vacuum appears thermal to an observer accelerated with respect to the Rindler observer. We study the same construction at an algebraic level for conformal field theories. At each step, a parent wedge is conformally mapped to a reference Minkowski spacetime, where a new right Rindler wedge and its left sibling are selected. We illustrate that under the Bisognano--Wichmann property, thermality holds at every generation: the state associated with a parent wedge becomes a KMS state when restricted to its right child. Further, using the modular structure of the wedge and its causal sibling, we identify the sibling algebra with the modular commutant and derive the corresponding recursive modular flow explicitly.
summary:
1. 该工作将嵌套林德勒楔中的递归热性置于共形场论的代数框架，逐代构造父楔到参考闵可夫斯基时空的共形映射并考察子楔限制。
2. 其核心在于借助Bisognano-Wichmann性质证明每一代父楔态限制到右子楔均为KMS态，并由楔与因果姊妹的模结构将姊妹代数识别为模交换子、显式导出递归模流。
3. 这为递归热性提供模理论层面的代数表述，并可启发在更一般量子场论与弯曲背景中检验嵌套视界的热性。

title: Nambu-Goldstone Bosons and Quantum Fisher Information
abstract: The quantum Fisher matrix and geometric tensor are powerful tools for quantifying the nature of quantum systems. Unfortunately, the formalism needed to compute these quantities is opaque and has limited the development of physical intuition for their behavior, even in the ground state. For quantum systems with continuous symmetries, we know the ground state can be understood in a model-independent and intuitive way from the correlation functions of conserved currents and charges. In this paper, we demonstrate an equivalence between the quantum Fisher matrix associated with the ground states of systems with continuous symmetries and the Nambu-Goldstone. bosons produced by broken generators. We will show that the information metric defined by the Fisher matrix is the same as the Zamolodchikov metric that defines the coset space of the system. Next we show that the Uhlmann curvature associated with multi-parameter estimation is the same as the charge density matrix that defines the difference between type-A and type-B Nambu-Goldstone bosons. We demonstrate these connections in several examples and discuss the generalization to finite temperature.
summary:
1. 该文建立了连续对称破缺基态下量子Fisher矩阵与Nambu-Goldstone玻色子之间的等价关系，并证明Fisher矩阵定义的信息度规对应Zamolodchikov度规、Uhlmann曲率对应刻画type-A与type-B玻色子差异的电荷密度矩阵。
2. 其核心卖点是以守恒流和荷的关联函数为桥梁，把原本不透明的量子几何与多参数估计量赋予模型无关的对称破缺直观解释，并在若干示例中验证及讨论有限温推广。
3. 这为量子计量、多参数量子几何与对称破缺物相研究提供统一语言，并提示可通过测量Fisher信息与Uhlmann曲率来探测Nambu-Goldstone模式及其类型。

title: Scale-separated AdS vacua on Riemann-Flat Manifolds
abstract: Supergravity compactifications supported by fluxes and Casimir energy offer a simple strategy to concoct explicit, controlled and isolated vacua with parametric scale separation and soft supersymmetry breaking. Exploiting the special properties of both the Casimir and flux potentials with respect to Laplacian operators in moduli space, we prove that the simplest such class of solutions, given by toroidal compactifications of eleven-dimensional supergravity threaded by any fluxes, always exhibit perturbative instabilities in the form of tachyonic modes below the BF bound. This no-go theorem applies to any toroidal supergravity compactification supported by $p$-form fluxes. We also study compactifications on more general Riemann-flat manifolds (RFM's). Concretely, we find a tachyon-free AdS$_4$ vacuum by compactifying M-Theory on a $T^7/\mathbb{Z}_2^3$. This constitutes the first ever example of a fully top-down, perturbatively stable, scale-separated AdS without localized sources.
summary:
1. 该工作证明任何由p-形式通量支撑的环面超引力紧化都含低于BF界的不稳定快子模，并在更一般Riemann平坦流形上构造尺度分离的AdS4真空。
2. 其关键是利用Casimir势和通量势在模空间Laplacian下的特殊性质导出环面紧化的no-go定理，并发现M理论在T^7/Z2^3上紧化可得到无快子解。
3. 这一无定域源、微扰稳定且尺度分离的自上而下AdS4实例表明非环面Riemann平坦流形可绕过环面不稳定性，为受控真空构建提供明确路径。

title: Bilocal flows and universality with field-dependent regulators
abstract: Many functional renormalization group flows employ a regulator that depends on the fields, as in proper-time and spectrally adjusted flows and in background-independent formulations of gauge theories and quantum gravity. Such a regulator generates additional terms in the flow, and their omission may spoil universality. We introduce bilocal flows, in which the effective action depends on the field and on the cutoff kernel as independent variables. The construction identifies the additional terms, and an exact sum rule shows that the first nontrivial coefficient of the anomalous dimension coincides with that of a fixed-regulator flow for every admissible regulator profile, so that universality is restored. For massless $\lambda\phi^4$ theory with a proper-time regulator, the reduced flow gives a profile-dependent anomalous dimension, while the completed flow gives the universal two-loop coefficient $C_\eta=1/6$ for every profile.
summary:
1. 该工作提出双局域流框架，将有效作用量视为场与截断核的独立泛函，以系统识别场依赖调节子产生的额外项。
2. 其卖点在于用精确求和规则证明：对所有可允许的调节子剖面，反常维度首个非平庸系数均与固定调节子流一致，从而恢复普适性。
3. 对无质量λφ^4理论，约化流给出依赖剖面的反常维度，而完整流在任意剖面下均给出两圈普适系数C_η=1/6，为背景无关规范场与量子引力中的场依赖截断提供可检验方案。

title: Deconfinement on $\mathbb{Z}_{F}$ and Axion Domain Walls
abstract: We investigate the nontrivial dynamics on $\mathbb{Z}_{F}$ domain walls and compute their tension in quantum chromodynamics (QCD) compactified on a circle with $N$ colors and $F < N$ massless fundamental flavors. In the process, we obtain insights on the $\eta'$ meson's potential in a regime where it is heavy and comparable in mass to other QCD resonances, as in Nature. We employ a center-stabilized compactification of QCD on a small circle of size $L$ with color-flavor twisted boundary conditions for the quarks. We demonstrate that probe particles in color representations of $N$-ality $N/\mathrm{gcd}(N,F)$ are deconfined on the $\mathbb{Z}_{F}$ domain walls whenever $N$ and $F$ are not coprime. This is reminiscent of deconfinement on axion domain walls in pure Yang--Mills. Finally, in the double scaling limit $N\rightarrow \infty$ keeping $NL$ and $F$ fixed, the infrared spectrum spans an emergent dimension. We establish that the $\mathbb{Z}_{F}$ domain walls are dual to electrostatic charge distributions in this emergent dimension. This duality allows us to compute their tension analytically and find a different tension scaling at large-$N$ between $\mathbb{Z}_{F}$ domain walls in QCD and axion domain walls in pure Yang--Mills, in center-stabilized compactifications.
summary:
1. 该工作在中心稳定化的小圆紧致化QCD中引入色-味扭曲边界条件，研究 Z_F 畴壁动力学并计算其张力，同时分析重 η′ 介子势。
2. 关键在于证明当 N 与 F 不互素时，N-ality 为 N/gcd(N,F) 的探针色表示在 Z_F 畴壁上退禁闭；并在 N→∞ 且固定 NL、F 的双标度极限下，把畴壁对偶为涌现维度中的静电荷分布以解析求张力。
3. 该对偶表明QCD的 Z_F 畴壁与纯杨–米尔斯轴子畴壁在大 N 下具有不同张力标度，并为借助涌现维度理解紧致化规范理论红外谱提供启发。

title: Gravitational Path Integral and String Theory
abstract: Gravitational path integral has had many applications in recent years. Using the example of supersymmetric index, which provides one of the most controlled tests of gravitational path integral, we argue that even in this controlled case, naive gravitational path integral cannot produce consistent results beyond low orders. However one can go further using stringy inputs, e.g. the choice of UV cut-off and the choice of correct path integration variable, without having to do full fledged string calculation. We also discuss to what extent we are led to string scale UV cut-off even if we begin with a supergravity theory without an a priori bias towards string theory. This is a review of mostly published results, but we clarify several details.
summary:
1. 该文综述引力路径积分与弦理论的关系，并以超对称指数这一受控检验为例评估朴素引力路径积分的适用边界。
2. 其核心论点是朴素引力路径积分超出低阶便难以给出一致结果，但引入弦论性输入——恰当紫外截断与正确路径积分变量——可在不做完整弦计算的情况下继续推进。
3. 文章进一步讨论即使从无弦论先验偏好的超引力出发也可能被引向弦尺度紫外截断，从而凸显路径积分定义中紫外完备性与变量选择的关键作用。

title: Classical solitons in anti-self-dual Yang-Mills theory
abstract: We study classical soliton solutions in split-signature anti-self-dual Yang-Mills theory. Using Zakharov's dressing method, we construct rational lump solitons, which are localised near two-dimensional surfaces, and wall solitons, which have codimension one. We further describe multi-phase solutions which have multiple walls meeting at trivalent junctions and form four-dimensional foam-like structures. Two-pole solutions describe soliton interactions and we find non-trivial colour-dressed phase shifts for wall interactions. We consider the four-dimensional analogue of Ward's lump scattering for the restricted kinematics of coincident poles and show that there are non-trivial interactions in the collinear limit. Finally, we show that the determinant of the soliton matrix provides a $\tau$-function which acts as a potential for gauge-invariant scalar quantities such as the Yang-Mills Lagrangian density.
summary:
1. 该文在分裂号差反自对偶杨-米尔斯理论中，用扎哈罗夫修饰法构造了局域于二维面的有理型块状孤子、余维一的壁孤子，以及多壁在三分叉结相交并形成四维泡沫结构的多相解。
2. 其技术卖点是通过双极点解刻画孤子相互作用并给出壁相互作用的非平凡色修饰相移，同时在共线极限下揭示非平庸的沃德型块状散射。
3. 作者进一步表明孤子矩阵行列式给出的τ函数可作为杨-米尔斯拉氏量密度等规范不变标量势，这为研究高维孤子网络与规范场非微扰结构提供了可操作框架。

title: Flux Vacua, Asymptotic Periods, and Relatively Anosov Representations
abstract: We develop a topological method to detect classical flux vacua of M-theory on Calabi-Yau fourfolds with a single complex structure modulus using only asymptotic period data and monodromy information. To this end, we express the index of the F-term of the flux superpotential as a winding number along the boundary of the universal cover of the complex structure moduli space. The index evaluates to a sum over zeros and poles of a suitably normalized boundary F-term, where local contributions can be computed algebraically on a dense set of boundary points. Assuming a conjectured bound on the remaining contributions, sufficiently many sign changes of the boundary F-term guarantee a flux vacuum in the interior. We illustrate the method on the mirror Fermat sextic with explicit examples and a systematic flux scan. A main technical ingredient in our construction is a continuity result for projective period maps: we prove that the non-holomorphic (3,1)-period map extends continuously to the boundary of the covering space if the monodromy representation is relatively Anosov. In general, this property does not hold for holomorphic (4,0)-periods.
summary:
1. 该工作发展了仅依赖渐近周期数据与单值信息、在具有单个复结构模量的Calabi-Yau四流形上探测M理论经典通量真空的拓扑方法。
2. 其卖点是把通量超势F项指标表示为复结构模空间万有覆盖边界上的绕数，并化为归一化边界F项零点与极点求和；还证明单值表示相对Anosov时非全纯(3,1)周期映射可连续延拓至边界，而全纯(4,0)周期一般不然。
3. 在剩余贡献满足所设猜想界时，边界F项足够多次变号即可保证内部通量真空，为系统通量扫描及渐近Hodge理论与Anosov表示的交叉提供可计算判据。

title: IR extremality and UV softness in string bootstrap
abstract: Whether string amplitudes can be characterized by extremality within the space of consistent S-matrices is an intriguing question. We address this question within the framework of positivity bootstrap. We compute positivity bounds by minimizing the $F^4$ Wilson coefficient while fixing subleading coefficients, and show that the Veneziano amplitude lies close to the boundary of the allowed region. However, this numerical proximity does not imply exact extremality, as demonstrated by explicit counterexamples. When additional KLT-motivated UV softness is imposed, the Veneziano amplitude is found to uniquely minimize the $F^4$ coefficient for $4\leq D\leq10$, connecting the extremality of the Veneziano amplitude to its stringy UV behavior and offering a new perspective on what makes string theory special.
summary:
1. 该工作在正性 bootstrap 框架下，通过固定次领头系数并最小化 F^4 Wilson 系数计算正性界，检验 Veneziano 振幅能否在一致 S-矩阵空间中达到极值。
2. 其关键在于数值上 Veneziano 虽接近允许区域边界，但显式反例表明这不等同于精确极值；引入 KLT 启发的 UV 软性后，它在 4≤D≤10 唯一最小化 F^4 系数。
3. 这将 Veneziano 振幅的极值性与弦论 UV 软行为联系起来，为理解弦论何以特殊提供新视角，并提示 UV 软性假设在正性界刻画中的关键作用。

title: AdS$_2$ from Type IIA on weak G$_2$ manifolds
abstract: We present and study supersymmetric warped ${\rm AdS}_2 \times {\rm M}_7 \times I$ solutions of Type IIA supergravity, where M$_7$ is a weak G$_2$ holonomy manifold. Locally, the solutions are characterized by a cubic polynomial. We distinguish two branches, Branch 1 and Branch 2, and analyze their global properties, taking flux quantization into account. At the endpoints of the interval $I$ they exhibit either OF1-plane or O8/D8 type of singularities with Branch 1 allowing also for a Spin(7) cone. In the case of zero Romans mass, Branch 1 uplifts to eleven dimensions to ${\rm AdS}_4 \times {\rm M}_7$ whereas Branch 2 uplifts to warped ${\rm AdS}_3 \times {\rm M}_7 \times I$ with OM2-plane type of singularities.
summary:
1. 该文构造并系统研究了Type IIA超引力中一类超对称warped AdS2×M7×I解，其中M7为弱G2 holonomy流形。
2. 其技术要点是解由三次多项式局域刻画，并区分两支、结合通量量子化分析整体性质及端点OF1/O8-D8型（Branch 1还可含Spin(7)锥）奇异性。
3. 零Romans质量时Branch 1可提升为11维AdS4×M7，Branch 2提升为带OM2奇点的warped AdS3×M7×I，为AdS2/CFT1及M理论嵌入提供具体候选。

title: Mapping AdS$_4$ quantum gravity via the Bethe Ansatz formula
abstract: The topologically twisted index of 3d ADHM theory can be written as a sum over solutions to the Bethe Ansatz Equations (BAEs) of the XXZ-type model constructed from quantum toroidal $\mathfrak{g}\mathfrak{l}_1$. Via a novel numerical algorithm, we solve for all $p(N)$ physical solutions at $N\leq 21$, where $p(N)$ denotes the number of integer partitions of $N$. Surveying these solutions, we find that in addition to the known "1-cut" solution dual to dyonic black holes, where the gauge holonomies are distributed along a single curve in the complex plane, there are "dressed" 1-cut solutions dual to combined configurations of the black hole and M2-branes, $m$-cut solutions dual to $\mathbb{Z}_m$ orbifolds of the black hole, a discrete family of solutions interpolating between the 1-cut and 3-cut solutions, together with other exotic solutions, at each value of $N$. The free energy of the interpolating solutions cannot be matched with the on-shell action of any known bulk solution. The $1,2,3$-cut solutions and interpolating solutions all have a well-defined large $N$ limit, and their leading order distribution of gauge holonomies can be computed analytically. Whenever possible, we fit the contributions of the solutions to the index to all orders in the $1/N$ expansion with high-precision numerics, and extract the leading non-perturbative correction. With exceptions, these are matched with the results of equivariant localization in the bulk, and the action of wrapped M2-branes respectively.
summary:
1. 该工作基于Bethe Ansatz公式，用新型数值算法求解3d ADHM理论拓扑扭化指标对应的XXZ型Bethe方程，在N≤21获得全部p(N)个物理解并系统分类。
2. 其核心发现是除对偶双荷黑洞的1-cut解外，还存在dressed 1-cut、m-cut orbifold、1-cut到3-cut插值及奇异解，并解析给出大N规范holonomy分布、完成高精度1/N拟合与非微扰修正提取。
3. 插值解自由能无法匹配已知bulk on-shell作用量，暗示AdS4量子引力中仍有未识别的体解，而多数解可与bulk equivariant localization及wrapped M2膜作用量对应。

title: A group theoretic calculation of multi-invariants of some stabilizer states
abstract: We study multi-invariants---a multi-partite generalization of Renyi entropies---of simple stabilizer states, for an arbitrary replica symmetry group. We develop a group theoretic technique for evaluating such invariants, which operates on the replica group and involves counting intersections among its cosets. Our techniques streamline the calculations of multi-invariants for graph states with two GHZ-like nodes and for certain generalizations thereof. The methodology developed here is most suitable when the quantum state is simple but flexibility over the replica group is desired.
summary:
1. 该工作针对任意复制对称群，研究简单稳定子态的多重不变量（Renyi熵的多分体推广），并建立了一套基于群论的系统计算方法。
2. 其核心在于把不变量的求值转化为复制群上的组合计数，即统计各陪集之间的交集，从而简化了含两个GHZ类节点的图态及其推广情形的计算。
3. 该方法最适用于量子态结构简单但需灵活选择复制群的场景，为稳定子态多分体纠缠与Renyi类量的解析评估提供了可推广的工具。

title: Realization of de Sitter spacetime in AdS/CFT
abstract: We construct horizonless, everywhere-regular solitons containing a de~Sitter core inside an asymptotically anti--de~Sitter spacetime, using an ordinary action of Einstein gravity, a Maxwell field, and a charged scalar. The object is a gravitating gauged $Q$-ball whose false-vacuum interior acts as a positive effective cosmological constant, sourcing an inner de~Sitter region joined through a thin wall to a charged, asymptotically AdS exterior. Two general requirements are emphasized: the scalar must lie in a near-false-vacuum (slow-roll--like) regime, and the exterior is driven to the extremal Reissner--Nordström--AdS locus in the thin-wall limit, in which the wall approaches the common would-be horizon. Since the solution is static and spherically symmetric, it may correspond to a semiclassical charge-$Q$ state of the dual CFT, realizing de~Sitter space approximately within a holographic theory. We also discuss free fluctuations whose de~Sitter--core modes appear as parametrically low-lying excitations above the state, bulk reconstruction, and the near-extremal regime, where finite-${\mathcal N}$ effects are expected to cut off the formal classical throat and replace its independent free-field modes by an interacting near-throat sector.
summary:
1. 该工作利用爱因斯坦引力、麦克斯韦场与带电标量的普通作用量，构造了嵌入渐近反德西特时空、内部含德西特核且无视界、处处正则的孤子解。
2. 其关键机制是将引力化规范Q球假真空内部视为正有效宇宙学常数，并经薄壁连接到带电渐近AdS外部；标量需处于近假真空慢滚区，薄壁极限下外部趋近极端Reissner-Nordström-AdS轨迹并与共同“视界”重合。
3. 该静态球对称解或对应对偶CFT的半经典电荷Q态，从而在全息理论中近似实现德西特空间，并为德西特核低激发、体重建及有限N截断近喉区自由模等研究提供入口。

title: Classical and Stochastic Trans-Planckian Censorship
abstract: The trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC) limits inflation to a deadline of $N_{\rm TCC}=\ln(M_{\rm Pl}/H_{\rm end})$ e-folds. We formulate it in stochastic inflation as a bound at confidence $1-\delta$ on the probability that a history outlasts the deadline, with three readings: one worldline, the region grown from one Hubble patch, and the reheated volume. Each reading becomes a closed-form condition, rigorous for a linear roll in leading-order stochastic inflation (for the region, in a branching model) and sharp at leading order in $N_{\rm TCC}$: a linear roll whose classical history lasts $N_{\rm cl}$ e-folds respects the TCC if $1-N_{\rm cl}/N_{\rm TCC}\geq\{2\mathcal{P}_\zeta[w+\ln(1/\delta)/N_{\rm TCC}]\}^{1/2}$, with $w=0$ for a worldline and $w=3$ for a region. On a linear slope without vacuum decay, the worldline and region readings are never weaker than the classical TCC, and on the CMB-normalized attractor all readings agree closely with it, so the bounds on the scale of inflation stand. A classical phase that ends in a flat quantum well, which the overdamped classical TCC excludes, is allowed with a margin of a few e-folds per worldline. Near the onset of eternal inflation, the readings differ. On a linear slope, a region must leave the fraction $\sqrt{6\mathcal{P}_\zeta}$ of the deadline unused at leading order: eternal inflation is excluded for every classical history that uses a finite fraction of the deadline, as is a band of non-eternal slopes, and the slope bound becomes $|V'|>V^{3/2}/[\sqrt2\,\pi(1-N_{\rm cl}/N_{\rm TCC})]$. Per worldline, every slope is allowed, given a margin of a few standard deviations. A false vacuum must decay at about the eternal threshold $\Gamma=9H^4/(4\pi)$ or faster for a region or the volume, but only faster than $3H^4\ln(1/\delta)/(4\pi N_{\rm TCC})$ per worldline. Whether the TCC forbids eternal inflation depends on the reading.
summary:
1. 该文在随机暴胀中重述跨普朗克审查猜想（TCC），把暴胀期限约束写成置信度1−δ下历史超过期限概率的界，并区分为单世界线、一个哈勃斑块生长区域和再加热体积三种读法。
2. 其技术卖点是对线性滚动导出含w=0（世界线）与w=3（区域）的闭式概率判据，在领头阶随机暴胀中严格且在N_TCC领头阶尖锐，并显示区域读法在永恒暴胀阈值附近要求留下√(6Pζ)比例的期限。
3. 因此TCC是否排除永恒暴胀取决于随机读法，但在宇宙微波背景归一化吸引子上各读法接近经典TCC，故现有暴胀能标限制稳健；假真空衰变率则获得依读法而变的界。

title: Pfaffian solutions to the Ernst equation
abstract: We show that the Yamazaki-Hori solution to the Ernst equation can be represented in the Pfaffian form. We also discuss the consequences of this result for Nakamura's conjecture on the relation between the Ernst equation and the 2D Toda model.
summary:
1. 该工作证明Ernst方程的Yamazaki-Hori解可表示为Pfaffian形式，从而给出该解的一种紧凑的代数表达。
2. 其核心卖点在于用Pfaffian结构显式刻画解的组织方式，并据此讨论Nakamura关于Ernst方程与二维Toda模型关联的猜想所带来的后果。
3. 这一表示为理解Ernst方程的可积结构及其与二维Toda模型的对应提供了可检验的代数线索，并可能启发后续对相关猜想与解族的系统研究。

title: Holographic Reconstruction from Broken Conformal Gauge Symmetry
abstract: We investigate bulk--boundary structures in $\AdS_4/\CFT_3$ from the viewpoint of gravity as a broken phase of conformal gauge symmetry. A crucial distinction is made between the Euler and Pontryagin characteristic classes. The gauge-theoretic gravitational action contains an Euler sector, whose total-derivative representation gives a boundary form depending on both intrinsic and extrinsic geometry. This structure is different from the Pontryagin descent to the three-dimensional gravitational Chern--Simons functional, whose metric variation gives the Cotton tensor and underlies the mixed boundary conditions studied by de Haro. We perform a Fefferman--Graham expansion of the Euler boundary form in asymptotically $\AdS_4$ spacetime. The normalizable coefficient $g_{(3)ij}$ does not contribute linearly to the finite Euler boundary term: its contribution from the cubic extrinsic- curvature sector vanishes by $\mathrm{Tr}\,g_{(3)}=0$, while curvature-- extrinsic-curvature terms containing $g_{(3)}$ vanish at the conformal boundary. A direct Codazzi analysis additionally shows that the Cotton tensor appears in the asymptotic mixed curvature but its contribution through the tangential-connection boundary variation vanishes for standard Dirichlet data. This indicates two distinct types of bulk--boundary structure: a global/topological Euler relation and a local Pontryagin--Cotton relation. We distinguish this kinematic Cotton appearance from a finite Cotton boundary response and discuss the implications for holographic reconstruction.
summary:
1. 该工作从共形规范对称性破缺视角研究AdS4/CFT3体-边界结构，并区分Euler类与Pontryagin类的不同作用。
2. 其核心是对Euler边界形式作Fefferman–Graham展开，证明g_(3)因Tr g_(3)=0及曲率-外曲率项在共形边界消失而不线性进入有限边界项，且Codazzi分析显示Cotton张量在标准Dirichlet数据下无切向联络边界变分贡献。
3. 这揭示全局/拓扑Euler关系与局部Pontryagin–Cotton关系并存，并强调须把Cotton张量的运动学出现与有限Cotton边界响应区分开，从而约束全息重构。

title: Learning the open string spectrum with neural networks
abstract: The tree-level open superstring has an integer mass-squared spectrum on linear Regge trajectories. To what extent is this fixed by consistency conditions: locality, analyticity, crossing, unitarity together with the requirement that $2\to2$ scattering minimize the entanglement it generates? Using the local two-channel crossing symmetric dispersion relation with one-parameter ambiguity ($\lambda$-CSDR) we set up a bootstrap treating both the mass-squared spectrum and the partial-wave coefficients as unknowns which lets the machine learning algorithm to learn the mass-squared spectrum and partial-wave coefficients simultaneously, going beyond earlier work in which the spectrum was fixed. Using the local three-channel crossing symmetric dispersion relation with one-parameter ambiguity we obtain, within the class of amplitudes with soft Regge behavior and infinite higher-spin tower, a bound on the leading Wilson coefficients that we compare with existing bounds and trace to spin-0 dominance. We locate the Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude in the allowed region of the Wilson coefficients space. For amplitudes with two-channel crossing symmetry we find that a Non-dual amplitude exhibits a Polchinski-Strassler type transition from Regge to power-law behavior.
summary:
1. 该工作利用带单参数歧义的局部两通道/三通道交叉对称色散关系与自举方法，把开弦质量平方谱和分波系数同时作为未知量交由机器学习求解。
2. 卖点在于突破先前固定谱的限制，可在软Regge行为与无限高自旋塔假设下给出前导Wilson系数的界，并将Virasoro-Shapiro振幅定位在允许区、追溯至自旋0主导。
3. 对于两通道交叉对称振幅，非对偶解呈现从Regge到幂律行为的Polchinski-Strassler型转变，为用一致性条件约束弦谱与有效系数提供可检验启示。

title: Thermodynamic Supercritical Scaling Law for the charged Gauss-Bonnet AdS Black Hole
abstract: The phase structure of the charged Gauss-Bonnet AdS black holes varies with the spacetime dimension. Within an appropriate parameter range, only the six-dimensional case admits two physical critical points and it is an ideal model for investigating supercritical thermodynamics in black hole systems with multiple critical points. In this study, we investigate the supercritical thermodynamic properties of this model in the extended phase space and construct the supercritical phase diagrams associated with the two critical points. The thermodynamic supercritical scaling analysis for the supercritical crossover lines in the vicinity of both critical points is completed, demonstrating universality. The corresponding coefficients for the external field scaling and the order parameter scaling are obtained, and their physical significance is discussed.
summary:
1. 该工作针对相结构随维数变化的带电Gauss-Bonnet AdS黑洞，在扩展相空间中选取唯一具有两个物理临界点的六维情形，构建并分析其超临界相图。
2. 核心卖点是完成两个临界点附近超临界交叉线的热力学标度分析，表明其普适性，并给出外场标度与序参量标度的系数及其物理解释。
3. 这为多临界点黑洞超临界热力学的统一描述和后续对普适标度系数的检验提供了明确框架。

title: Free-field realizations of $\mathcal{N} = 1$ supersymmetric $\mathcal{W}$-algebras associated with Lie superalgebras $B (n - 1 , n)$ and $B (n , n)$
abstract: We extend the recursive construction of free-field realizations proposed by Ide, Ito, and Miyazaki to the $\mathcal{N} = 1$ supersymmetric $\mathcal{W}$-algebras $\mathcal{SW} B (n - 1 , n)$ and $\mathcal{SW} B (n , n)$, associated with the Lie superalgebras $B (n - 1 , n)$ and $B (n , n)$, respectively. We obtain explicit free-field realizations of $\mathcal{SW} B (0 , 1)$, $\mathcal{SW} B (1 , 1)$, $\mathcal{SW} B (1 , 2)$, and $\mathcal{SW} B (2 , 2)$. In particular, the realizations of $\mathcal{SW} B (1 , 2)$ and $\mathcal{SW} B (2 , 2)$ are new. Using these realizations, we compute central charges, conformal weights, and eigenvalues of the generating currents on free-field highest-weight states, and construct the local integrals of motion $I_1$, $I_3$, and $I_5$.
summary:
1. 该文把Ide、Ito与Miyazaki的自由场实现递归构造推广到李超代数B(n-1,n)与B(n,n)对应的N=1超对称W代数SWB(n-1,n)和SWB(n,n)。
2. 工作给出SWB(0,1)、SWB(1,1)、SWB(1,2)、SWB(2,2)的显式自由场实现，其中后两者为新结果，并据此计算中心荷、共形权重、生成流在自由场最高权重态上的本征值以及局域运动积分I1、I3、I5。
3. 这些显式实现为检验相关超对称W代数的表示论、谱数据与可积结构提供了可直接使用的构造基准。

title: Monodromy line defects on the fuzzy sphere
abstract: Monodromy line defects are of interest in the defect bootstrap program and are dual to electrically charged objects in dual gauge field descriptions. We investigate the Ising monodromy dCFT using a fuzzy sphere regularization, by imposing the twisted boundary condition in the UV. We obtain defect scaling dimensions $\hat \Delta$ and ratios of defect operator expansion (DOE) coefficients using this method. We extend this machinery to the continuous family of $O(2)$ monodromy defects with twist angle $2\pi\nu$. In both cases, the lowest neutral defect scalar lies above dimension one, providing evidence that the monodromy defect reaches a stable dCFT without additional fine tuning.
summary:
1. 该工作用模糊球正则化，在紫外端施加扭曲边界条件，研究 Ising 单值线缺陷 dCFT，并计算缺陷标度维数与缺陷算符展开系数比。
2. 其技术卖点是将该方法推广至扭转角为 2πν 的连续 O(2) 单值缺陷族，并发现两类情形下最低中性缺陷标量维数均高于一，表明无需额外精细调节即可达到稳定 dCFT。
3. 这为单值线缺陷的数值研究、缺陷 bootstrap 以及对偶规范描述中的带电对象提供了可扩展的检验途径。

title: Non-minimal unimodular inflation revisited: Swampland diagnostics and CMB constraints
abstract: We study non-minimal unimodular inflation in the Einstein frame; the effective potential takes the form $U(\varphi)=U_0(1+\xi\varphi^2/\mpl^2)^{-2}$. We consider the canonical field map and the inflationary observables directly from the Einstein-frame action. The exact potential slow-roll parameters, the leading scalar running, the scalar-amplitude normalization, the e-fold relation, and the end-of-inflation condition are obtained analytically. The model has a nontrivial structural tension: an $\epsilon_V=1$ exit requires $\xi>1/2$, whereas the near-origin slow-roll regime requires $\xi\ll1$ and gives $n_s\simeq1-8\xi$. We next test three distinct swampland diagnostics. The further-refined de Sitter conjecture (FRDSSC) introduces the independent conjectural parameters $a$, $b$, and $q$, while the scalar weak gravity conjecture (SWGC) and its strong form (SSWGC) contain no analogous tunable conjecture parameter in the single-field realization adopted here. All three criteria are evaluated using the canonically normalized Einstein-frame scalar. Analytic limits show that the SWGC is violated at the stationary point for every nonzero $\xi$, whereas the SSWGC at that point requires $\xi\gtrsim0.0643$. In the large-field limit both scalar weak-gravity diagnostics reduce to the same threshold $\xi\ge0.1$. Numerical scans then show that the observationally relevant ACT/P-ACT region does not satisfy either scalar weak-gravity criterion, while the FRDSSC can be satisfied for $a$ close to unity. Consequently, the minimal model can reproduce acceptable $(n_s,r)$ at isolated field values, but this does not constitute a complete 50-60 e-fold inflationary history or simultaneous satisfaction of all three conjectures.
summary:
1. 该文在爱因斯坦框架下重新研究非最小幺模暴胀，对有效势 U=U0(1+ξφ²/mpl²)^−2 解析导出精确慢滚参数、标量跑动、振幅归一化、e 折数与结束条件，并检验沼泽地诊断和 CMB 约束。
2. 其卖点是揭示结构性张力：εV=1 退出需 ξ>1/2，而近原点慢滚需 ξ≪1 且 ns≈1−8ξ；SWGC 对任意非零 ξ 在驻点被违反，SSWGC 需 ξ≳0.0643，大场极限二者均化为 ξ≥0.1，且 ACT/P-ACT 区不满足标量弱引力判据，FRDSSC 仅在 a 接近 1 时可满足。
3. 故最小模型只能在孤立场值拟合 (ns,r)，无法给出完整 50–60 e 折历史或同时满足三种猜想，这为模型修正提供了硬约束。

title: Reconstructing the Goldberg-Palatini Action from Noether Identities
abstract: We investigate the reconstruction of the first-order gravitational action from the Noether identities associated with diffeomorphism invariance. The independent fields are a symmetric perturbation $\phi^{\mu\nu}$ of the contravariant metric density and a trace-adjusted connection $G^{\lambda}{}_{\mu\nu}$, whose transformation laws are prescribed. For a local action polynomial in these fields, with the gravitational coupling as its only dimensionful constant and each additional field carrying one power of it, a dilatation, which is a particular diffeomorphism, shows that in any dimension $d>2$ the action terminates at most at cubic order, its only possible cubic term being a derivative-free $\phi GG$ vertex. Expanding the kernels of the resulting Lorentz-covariant ansatz in tensor bases gives 31 coefficients for $d\geq 4$. The Noether identities with general diffeomorphisms, expanded order by order in the fields, yield a linear system that eliminates the $\phi\phi$ kernel and determines the remaining coefficients up to an overall normalization, recovering the Goldberg-Palatini action. Since the connection can be eliminated exactly, this also fixes the complete second-order action, with its infinite set of graviton vertices. The construction requires no choice of energy-momentum tensor, the source of ambiguity in the self-coupling approach. The kernel bases, the identities and the solution are given in appendices, and the symbolic computations are publicly available.
summary:
1. 该工作以对称逆变度规密度扰动和迹调整联络为独立场，从微分同胚诺特恒等式出发重构一阶引力作用量。
2. 其关键在于利用伸缩微分同胚将d>2的局域多项式作用量截断至三次且仅允许无导数φGG顶点，再以31个张量基系数和逐阶诺特恒等式线性求解，消去φφ核并将剩余系数定至整体归一化，从而恢复戈德堡-帕拉蒂尼作用量。
3. 由于联络可精确消去，该方法同时确定含无穷多引力子顶点的完整二阶作用量，并因无需预设能量动量张量而规避自耦合方案的源歧义。

title: Possible Microscopic source of torsion
abstract: Axial fermionic interactions connect vacuum condensation with torsionful back- grounds. We consider a quartic spin spin interaction whose mean field reduction yields a quadratic fermionic Hamiltonian. Its diagonalisation defines a particle and antiparticle condensate, while self consistency determines whether the vacuum devel- ops a non zero axial current. Cutoff, fluctuation and energy conditions delimit the validity of the approximation. When torsion couples to spin, this axial expectation value can provide a microscopic source for an axial torsion background. We then consider mixed Dirac fields on such a background. In the explicit neutrino analysis, metric curvature is neglected while torsion modifies the flavour Bogoliubov coeffi- cients, producing spin dependent oscillation frequencies, condensate densities and CP asymmetries.
summary:
1. 该文通过四费米子自旋-自旋相互作用的平均场约化与对角化，研究粒子-反粒子凝聚及自洽非零轴矢流能否为轴矢挠率背景提供微观来源。
2. 其关键点是在挠率与自旋耦合下以轴矢期望值作源，并在忽略度规曲率的混合狄拉克场中证明挠率修正味Bogoliubov系数，导致自旋依赖的振荡频率、凝聚密度与CP不对称。
3. 可辩护的启示是：此类自洽凝聚机制为检验挠率-自旋耦合及中微子味振荡中的自旋相关CP效应提供了可计算的微观框架，但其有效性受截断、涨落与能量条件限制。

title: Surface defects on lens space and transfer matrices
abstract: We study surface defects in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ theories of class $\mathcal{S}$ and $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories of class $\mathcal{S}_k$ placed on $L(r,1)\times S^1$. The lens space index depends on the fugacities $p$ and $q$, and the effect of the defects on it is captured by difference operators acting on the fugacities and holonomies of flavor symmetries. For theories of type $A_1$ we determine in closed form the difference operators for the basic defects, labeled by $p^r$, $q^r$ and $pq$, and show that for odd $r$ there exist additional elementary defects, whose operators shift the holonomy by one half modulo $r$. All the operators commute, and the elementary operators generate the others. For even $r$ the same holds once the holonomy is extended to a twisted sector. We show that the elementary operators are traces of $L$-operators whose entries generate a Sklyanin algebra, with nome $q^r$ and shift $pq$. The lens space enters only through the parameters of the algebra and through its representation, which is realized on a doubled holonomy label. The $p$- and $q$-type algebras form a lens space version of the elliptic modular double. For class $\mathcal{S}_k$ theories we propose, and test in several ways, that the defect operators are transfer matrices of inhomogeneous spin chains built from these $L$-operators. Throughout, we use the TQFT structure of the lens space index, which follows from S-duality, both to fix and to check the operators.
summary:
1. 该工作在 L(r,1)×S^1 上研究四维 N=2 的 S 类与 N=1 的 S_k 类中的表面缺陷，并用透镜空间指标确定作用于逸度与和乐的差分算符。
2. 对 A_1 型，作者给出标记 p^r、q^r、pq 的基本缺陷算符闭式，发现奇数 r 有平移和乐半整数模 r 的额外基本算符，且算符对易并由基本算符生成；偶数 r 经扭曲扇区亦然，并可由 Sklyanin 代数 L-算符的迹实现。
3. 这将 S_k 类的缺陷算符表述为这些 L-算符构建的非均匀自旋链转移矩阵，并借 S-对偶的拓扑量子场论结构校验，启示透镜空间指标、椭圆模双型代数与可积链的对应。

title: Finite Spectral Recurrences for Loop Integrals in de Sitter and Anti-de Sitter Space
abstract: We introduce a method that does for loop integrals in de Sitter and anti-de Sitter space what integration-by-parts identities do in flat space. A local, coordinate-free propagator algebra common to both geometries yields exact finite-difference equations in spectral labels; with external points they become differential-difference equations, and at the AdS boundary recover known Witten-diagram relations. Acting line by line, they apply in principle to any diagram. We solve them for the two-loop watermelon, isolating its ultraviolet poles, and for one-loop two- and four-point functions.
summary:
1. 该工作为 de Sitter 与反 de Sitter 空间的圈积分提出了一套类似平坦空间分部积分恒等式的递推方法。
2. 其核心是适用于两种几何的局域、无坐标传播子代数，可在谱标签上给出精确有限差分方程；带外点时为微分-差分方程，并在 AdS 边界退化为已知 Witten 图关系，且可逐线作用于任意图。
3. 作者用该方法求解两圈 watermelon 并分离紫外极点，以及单圈两点和四点函数，显示其可作为 dS/AdS 圈积分化简与极点提取的系统工具。

title: Causality violation in the holographic approach to N=4 SYM theory at finite 't Hooft coupling
abstract: In the AdS/CFT correspondence, correlation functions of the energy-momentum tensor in N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory at large but finite 't Hooft coupling can be studied using higher-derivative corrections to supergravity. We show that the commonly used holographic prescription for correlation functions which is obtained by truncating the equations of motion at order $(\alpha')^3$ implies that the thermal equilibrium state of N=4 SYM theory in the planar limit is dynamically unstable at arbitrarily large finite 't Hooft coupling. The instability is a reflection of the unphysical causality violation brought about by treating perturbatively-derived equations as if they were non-perturbative, analogous to the instability of AdS black branes in five-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet gravity. While other holographic prescriptions for treating the $O(\alpha'^3)$ corrections to supergravity may alleviate the pathology introduced by the truncation, the validity regime of the results obtained by any prescription at $O(\alpha'^3)$ must be limited to the strict perturbative treatment of the $O(\alpha'^3)$ effects on N=4 SYM observables.
summary:
1. 该工作研究大而有限't Hooft耦合下N=4超对称Yang-Mills平面极限热平衡态的全息描述，发现常用的O(α'^3)运动方程截断方案会导致动力学不稳定。
2. 其核心在于论证该不稳定并非物理预言，而是把微扰高阶导数方程当作非微扰理论使用所致的非物理因果性破坏，类似五维Gauss-Bonnet引力中AdS黑膜的不稳定性。
3. 这要求任何O(α'^3)全息方案的结果仅限严格微扰地处理对N=4 SYM可观测量的修正，其他处方或可缓解病理但无法据此主张非微扰有效性。

title: Cosmological correlators from the Euclidean sphere
abstract: We propose a new framework for computing late-time cosmological correlators in de Sitter spacetime by analytic continuation from the Euclidean sphere. In this framework, correlators of arbitrary massive scalar fields take the universal form of generalized Euler integrals. Using this representation, we reproduce the results obtained using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism for a range of tree-level and loop diagrams, providing nontrivial checks of the equivalence between the Euclidean and the in-in formalisms. We further show that a Landau analysis of the generalized Euler integrals determines the singularities of the corresponding correlators in momentum space. This framework provides a systematic approach to studying the analytic structure of cosmological correlators.
summary:
1. 该工作提出通过从欧氏球解析延拓计算德西特时空晚期宇宙学关联函数的新框架，并将任意质量标量场的关联函数统一表示为广义Euler积分。
2. 其技术卖点在于用该表示复现Schwinger-Keldysh形式下的多类树图与圈图结果，以检验欧氏与in-in形式的等价性，并借助广义Euler积分的Landau分析确定动量空间奇点。
3. 这为系统研究宇宙学关联函数的解析结构提供了可推广路径，并启示后续将奇点分析用于更广泛的关联函数与圈图计算。

title: Towards differential expansion for generic representations
abstract: We report the first results of phenomenological analysis, based on extended set of explicitly calculated colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials in \cite{knotebook}. They concern differential expansion (DE), which separates the dependencies on the knot ${\cal K}$ and the representation $R$. %of colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials. DE is well understood for symmetric and rectangular representations, while for non-rectangular $R$ even the knot-independent basis $Z_R^X$ of DE is not known. We concentrate on two issues: the possible derivation of DE and on improved characteristic of its defect. We discuss how evolution families -- twist knots, double braids and 3-pretzels -- can be used to find DE by a peculiar triangular transformation of evolution coefficients. Once $Z^R_X$ are found for particular family, they are expected to stay basically the same for arbitrary knots -- modulo controllable reductions, characterized by the defect of DE, which puts knots into different universality classes. Contrary to original expectation, these classes appear labeled not by a single number $\delta^{\cal K}$, but by a whole non-decreasing sequence $\{k_j\}$, which is squeezed between two staircases, ${\rm entier}\left(\frac{j-1}{\delta+1}\right)\leq k_j\leq{\rm entier}\left(\frac{j-1}{{\rm deg}\,\Delta}\right)$, where the upper bound involves Alexander polynomial $\Delta(q^2)$ and follows from the continuation of the Melvin--Morton--Rozansky-Kashaev limit to $A=q^{-m}$ with $m>0$, when the limit gives a {\it positive} power of Alexander. The old assumption $\delta+1={\rm deg}\,\Delta$ is oversimplified and fails for 19 non-alternating knots with 11 and 12 crossings. Last, we list the differences of non-rectangularly colored HOMFLY for various mutant pairs to demonstrate their universality (knot-independence) and nice consistency with the spirit of DE.
summary:
1. 该文基于扩展的显式彩色HOMFLY-PT多项式，首次对非矩形表示下的微分展开作唯象分析，聚焦其推导与缺陷刻画。
2. 其卖点是用扭转结、双辫和3-pretzel演化族，经演化系数的三角变换提取纽结无关基Z_R^X，并将缺陷从单一δ推广为受Alexander多项式与MMRK极限约束的非降序列{k_j}。
3. 该框架表明δ+1=degΔ在19个11/12交叉非交错纽结上失效，并为按缺陷划分纽结普适类及检验突变对彩色HOMFLY的纽结无关性提供依据。

title: Boundary One-Point Functions in the Open XXZ Spin Chain with Generic Integrable Boundaries
abstract: We consider the problem of computing observables beyond the spectrum in the open XXZ spin chain with the most generic integrable boundary conditions. For such boundaries, the residual u(1) symmetry is broken and the familiar Baxter TQ equation describing the spectrum becomes inhomogeneous, placing the model outside the realm of existing approaches to correlation functions and form factors. We show that the Functional Separation of Variables method, so far developed mainly for rational, (quasi-)periodic spin chains, is largely insensitive to these modifications, and works equally well for diagonal and generic boundaries. Using this method, we compute exact determinant expressions for a prototypical example of form factors in open-boundary systems, namely the longitudinal and transverse boundary-spin one-point functions in arbitrary Hamiltonian eigenstates at finite system size. No constraint relating the two boundary configurations and no reference state are required. We verify the resulting formulae against direct finite-volume diagonalisation.
summary:
1. 该工作针对具有最一般可积边界条件的开放XXZ自旋链，利用泛函分离变量法计算有限尺寸任意哈密顿量本征态中的纵向与横向边界自旋单点函数，并给出精确行列式表达式。
2. 其关键点在于该方法对残余U(1)对称性破缺及非齐次Baxter TQ方程不敏感，可同时处理对角与一般边界，且无需两个边界构型间的约束，也不依赖参考态，结果经有限体积直接对角化验证。
3. 这将超越能谱的相关函数与形状因子计算推广到一般可积开放边界，为开放链中的边界可观测量提供精确基准，并提示泛函分离变量法可适用于更广泛的对称性破缺可积模型。

title: Analytical solution of electromagnetic heating in a stratified absorbing medium
abstract: We consider the temperature evolution in a skin tissue when it is exposed to an electromagnetic wave. The heating is caused by the absorbed power as the electromagnetic wave attenuates inside the skin. In many applications, the characteristic depth of attenuation is small in comparison with the lateral size of the electromagnetic beam. Because of this separation of length scales, the lateral heat conduction is negligible at leading order. Previously, we studied electromagnetic heating in a skin of a single homogeneous layer. We derived the leading-term analytical solution and the asymptotic corrections up to the second order for lateral heat conduction and for oblique incidence. In this study, we derive the analytical solution in the case of perpendicular incidence on a stratified skin tissue with a layer-specific profile for electromagnetic attenuation. It should be emphasized that in the current study, the heat capacity and conductivity are still uniform over the entire skin tissue; only the electromagnetic attenuation is stratified resulting in a layer-specific heating profile.
summary:
1. 该文针对垂直入射电磁波在分层皮肤组织中的温升问题，在仅电磁衰减随层变化而热容与热导率全局均匀的设定下，推导出解析温度解。
2. 其关键在于利用衰减深度远小于光束横向尺度导致横向热传导在首阶可忽略，从而把单均匀层的解析框架推广到具有层特定加热剖面的分层介质。
3. 该解为分层组织电磁加热提供了可计算的基准，并提示可在保持解析可解性的同时评估层状衰减对温升分布的影响，后续可扩展到非均匀热参数或斜入射。

title: Counterexamples to the total-current Hohenberg-Kohn conjecture
abstract: The total-current Hohenberg-Kohn conjecture asserts that the ground-state particle density and total current determine the scalar potential up to an additive constant and the vector potential up to a gauge transformation. We give three counterexamples for two spinless fermions in the physically relevant setting of three spatial dimensions. In each, a Hamiltonian $H^{v,\mathbf{A}}$ has a nondegenerate ground state with identically zero total current but nonzero magnetic field. Complex conjugation then yields a second Hamiltonian $H^{v,-\mathbf{A}}$, with the same scalar potential and interaction, whose ground state has the same density and the same zero current, while the magnetic field is reversed. The first two examples are noninteracting. One is explicit, with a smooth bounded vector potential and a Gaussian density. The other has smooth bounded scalar and vector potentials in the standard potential spaces. The third example has Coulomb repulsion with unit coupling, an isotropic harmonic scalar potential, and Dirac monopole fields of magnetic charge $\pm 1/2$. The monopole example uses vector potentials defined on separate spatial patches, since these fields are not curls of globally defined smooth vector potentials.
summary:
1. 该文在三维两个无自旋费米子情形下构造三个反例，否定总电流Hohenberg-Kohn猜想：基态密度与总电流不足以唯一确定标量势和矢量势。
2. 核心构造是基态非简并且总电流恒为零而磁场非零，复共轭给出标量势与相互作用相同、密度和零电流相同但磁场反向的另一哈密顿量。
3. 例子包括非相互作用光滑有界势、标准势空间中的光滑势，以及单位库仑排斥、谐振标量势和±1/2狄拉克单极场（矢量势需分片定义），表明该猜想在三维物理情形下不普遍成立。

title: Continuous and Differentiable Neural Network Representations of the Surfzone Sea-Surface from Lidar Point Clouds
abstract: Ocean waves are often analyzed via sea-surface observations. Multi-beam scanning lidar enables two-dimensional measurements of the water surface $\eta(x,y)$ via sequenced point clouds of sea-surface elevation. Point cloud data, however, have to be gridded, interpolated, or mapped for use in wave analysis. We present and test a method for creating a continuous and differentiable (space and time), but grid-free, representation of the sea-surface from time sequenced lidar point clouds. We use a specific neural network architecture, a SIREN, to represent the sea-surface and to train the network on spatiotemporal 60~s of lidar data collected by a gas-electric UAS (drone) hovering over large (4 m), breaking waves in Monterey, California. The trained SIREN allows estimation of the sea-surface and its derivatives at any location and time. SIREN sea-surface representations tend to filter the highest wave number variability (splash-up and sea-spray). SIREN errors are comparable to instrument errors and insensitive to local data density. The reliability and reproducibility of our approach is tested by training two SIRENs independently on the same data. Differences between the two independent SIRENs are comparable to instrument error, but increase in data-poor regions. SIRENs' potential for directional wave analysis is demonstrated by computing spatial and temporal derivatives and by estimating wave velocity from a SIREN-generated space-time slice of the sea-surface.
summary:
1. 该工作提出并测试了一种基于SIREN神经网络的方法，用时序激光雷达点云构建无网格且时空连续可微的海面表示，并在无人机观测的4 m破碎波60 s数据上训练验证。
2. 其技术卖点是从训练后的网络中可在任意位置和时间解析估计海面及其导数，误差接近仪器误差且对局部点云密度不敏感，并倾向于滤除飞溅和浪花对应的高波数变率。
3. 该框架为方向波分析与波速估计提供了可复现途径，但两独立训练结果在数据稀疏区差异增大，提示其可靠性依赖数据覆盖。

title: Two routes to the Hadamard condition
abstract: In quantum field theory on curved spacetime, the Hadamard condition is often presented as a necessary condition on 'physically reasonable', 'vacuum-like' states of linear quantum fields, and plays a central role in many theoretical and foundational applications - ranging from proofs of the renormalizability of Wick polynomials to derivations of the Hawking temperature. In this paper, I strengthen, generalise, and bring under technical control two popular motivations for the Hadamard condition - one which appeals to the role of Hadamard states in defining physical quantities such as Wick polynomials and the expectation value of the stress-energy operator on general curved spacetime backgrounds, and one which appeals to the equivalence principle. This clarifies the role and status of the Hadamard condition, including its relationship to the equivalence principle, to well-definedness of physical quantities such as Wick polynomials and the expectation value of the stress-energy operator, and the sense in which Hadamard states are 'vacuum-like'.
summary:
1. 该工作强化、推广并以技术手段控制阿达马条件的两种常见动机：其一基于威克多项式与应力-能量张量期望值在一般弯曲时空中的定义，其二基于等效原理。
2. 其核心卖点在于厘清阿达马条件与等效原理、上述物理量良定义性以及阿达马态“类真空”含义之间的关系，从而受控地说明该条件的角色与地位。
3. 这为在弯曲时空量子场论的基础论证中更审慎地评估阿达马条件的必要性与适用边界提供了清晰框架，并启发后续形式化与物理论证。

title: Phonon Dispersion Relation in Weakly Coupled Bose Gas Beyond Bogoliubov Approximation
abstract: We study the quasiparticle dispersion relation for a homogeneous Bose gas in a large cubic box with periodic boundary conditions at zero temperature. Inspired by the Bogoliubov method, we rearrange the usual Bose gas Hamiltonian in a form adapted to perturbation theory in the weak-coupling regime, both in the canonical and grand-canonical setting. We compute the first non-trivial corrections to the dispersion relation in both settings. We show that for small momenta they are linear in the absolute value of the momentum. Thus, in this approximation phonons have a well-defined velocity, which we compute.
summary:
1. 该工作针对零温、周期性边界下大立方盒中的均匀弱耦合玻色气体，在正则与巨正则框架中重整玻色气体哈密顿量，并用微扰论计算声子色散关系的首个非平凡修正。
2. 其关键在于给出两种系综下小动量区域的修正，发现色散修正线性于动量绝对值，从而在所用近似内定义并计算声子的确定速度。
3. 这一结果将Bogoliubov图像推广到弱耦合微扰展开，并为检验有限体积玻色气体中声速与准粒子描述的一致性提供可操作基准。

title: Half-delocalization for semiclassical measures of split higher-dimensional quantum cat maps
abstract: We study quantum cat maps on multidimensional tori and prove an optimal lower bound for the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy of their semiclassical measures under the hypothesis that the dynamics splits over the rationals. This is the first instance of such a bound for a dynamical system with multiple positive Lyapunov exponents. The proof is based on a new notion of conditional quantum dynamical entropy and a careful study of the multiple Ehrenfest time adapted to the dynamics.
summary:
1. 该工作研究多维环面上的分裂型量子猫映射，在动力学于有理数上分裂的假设下，为其半经典测度的Kolmogorov-Sinai熵建立最优下界，从而给出半局域化的定量刻画。
2. 其技术卖点在于首次覆盖具有多个正Lyapunov指数的动力系统，并引入条件量子动力熵概念、细致处理适配动力学的多重Ehrenfest时间来完成证明。
3. 这一结果将高维半局域化与熵下界联系起来，为量子遍历性、多正Lyapunov指数系统的半经典对应及后续推广提供了明确的方法论启示。

title: The concentration conjecture for Dirac--Coulomb operators
abstract: We prove the concentration conjecture for the three-dimensional Dirac operator with mass $m>0$ and an attractive Coulomb potential generated by finitely many point charges. For a fixed total charge $G\in(0,1]$, the lowest eigenvalue in the spectral gap is at least $m\sqrt{1-G^2}$, with equality precisely when all the charge is concentrated at one point. The critical one-center operator is understood as its distinguished extension. The result also extends to arbitrary nonnegative finite charge measures. The proof uses a strict two-center estimate for the weighted free Dirac resolvent and a Birman-Schwinger comparison. We establish the two-center estimate through an auxiliary axial operator, combining a zero-energy bound and a scalar resolvent estimate with a radial decomposition, an angular Schur complement, and exact polynomial inequalities.
summary:
1. 该工作证明了三维质量为正的狄拉克算子在一组有限点电荷产生的吸引库仑势下的集中猜想。
2. 其核心结论是固定总电荷G∈(0,1]时谱隙内最低本征值不低于m√(1-G^2)，且等号仅当全部电荷集中于一点，证明依赖加权自由狄拉克预解式的严格双中心估计与Birman-Schwinger比较。
3. 该结果将临界单中心算子理解为特定延拓并推广至非负有限电荷测度，为多中心库仑势下狄拉克谱下界与极值构型提供了可检验的严格框架。

title: Matrix divisors, Christoffel transformations and symmetric $d$-connections
abstract: The Christoffel transformation $w(x)\mapsto x^2w(x)$ relates elementary bundle modifications to gap probability recurrences. The moment matrix determines normalization and the splitting type. We define the source and target moduli problems by their local data. The modifications identify common stable loci and conjugate their point-addition maps. For Pearson ratios $d(-z-1)/d(z)$ with $°d=1,2$, we construct rational spectral coordinates and compute the induced transformation. For positive even weights with finite moments, reweighting configurations yields the transformed gap probability recurrence. Its coefficient is a rational function of the transformed spectral coordinates. A local formula applies outside these charts under the stated hypotheses.
summary:
1. 该工作以矩阵除子与对称d-联络为框架，研究Christoffel变换 w(x)↦x^2w(x) 如何把初等丛修正与间隙概率递推联系起来，并由局部数据定义源与目标模空间问题。
2. 其核心在于用矩矩阵确定归一化与分裂型，指出相应修正识别共同稳定轨迹并共轭点加法映射；对次数为1、2的Pearson比构造有理谱坐标并显式计算诱导变换，且在正偶权与有限矩条件下得到系数为变换后谱坐标有理函数的间隙概率递推。
3. 这一表述把模空间、谱坐标与递推结构统一起来，并为在所述假设下将局部公式推广到图表之外及分析相关模型提供了明确出发点。

title: Concurrent Entanglement Purification Scheduling in Dynamic Quantum Networks
abstract: Quantum networks must deliver end-to-end entanglement whose fidelity meets application requirements, which typically requires entanglement purification along multi-hop paths. Existing scheduling approaches either purify at the link level or optimize end-to-end fidelity for a static set of requests, and do not capture concurrent requests competing for network resources over time. This paper studies concurrent entanglement purification scheduling in a time-slotted quantum network with heterogeneous links, in which requests compete for link capacity and quantum memories, and each request may be served by multiple parallel paths for increased reliability. We formulate a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) scheduler that maximizes the number of scheduled requests, with max-min path allocation as a fairness criterion, and develop reinforcement learning (RL) schedulers based on DQN, PPO, and SAC, whose rewards balance request success against Bell-pair consumption. Simulations under varying network load, topologies and target fidelity thresholds show that the RL schedulers achieve the highest success rates, improving on MILP by up to 6% and on Progressive Filling and Greedy heuristics by 16.5% and 19.5% respectively, at the cost of higher Bell pair consumption and the deferral of a small fraction of requests. MILP, in contrast, achieves the highest fairness and the lowest Bell pair consumption in most scenarios.
summary:
1. 该文研究时隙化异构量子网络中并发纠缠纯化调度，建立以最大化请求调度数为目标、采用最大最小路径分配公平准则的混合整数线性规划模型，并给出基于DQN、PPO和SAC的强化学习调度器。
2. 其核心在于让强化学习奖励同时权衡请求成功率与贝尔对消耗，在负载、拓扑和目标保真度变化下取得最高成功率，较MILP提升至多6%，较两种启发式分别提升16.5%和19.5%。
3. 这一结果表明成功率、公平性与贝尔对开销存在明确权衡，为动态量子网络中兼顾服务可靠性和资源效率的纯化调度提供了可验证的设计启示。

title: Active isolation of transmon readout with a tunable inductive bridge
abstract: Scalable superconducting quantum computation requires fast, high-fidelity readout. Currently, this is assisted through cryogenic amplification of the readout signal. In traditional dispersive readout schemes, the amplifiers that are used to provide high signal-to-noise ratio also generate thermal noise that can decohere the qubits, demanding additional ferrite-based isolators to suppress this noise. Here, we integrate a chip-scale microwave switch, the tunable inductive bridge, into the readout chain of a fixed-frequency transmon. Flux-pulsing the switch, such that it transmits only during the readout, did not make a discernable difference to qubit coherence, residual excited-state population, or readout fidelity metrics. By injecting broadband noise that mimics amplifier thermal photons, we show that the switch suppresses the resulting qubit dephasing by more than $30$~dB, consistent with its independently measured on-off ratio, establishing it as a potential chip-based integrated replacement for readout-chain isolators.
summary:
1. 该工作将可调电感桥这一芯片级微波开关集成到固定频率transmon的读出链中，并通过磁通脉冲使其仅在读出期间导通。
2. 在模拟放大器热光子的宽带噪声注入下，开关将由此引起的量子比特退相位抑制超过30 dB，且与独立测得的开关比一致，同时读出保真度、残余激发态布居和相干性未见可辨差异。
3. 这表明该器件可作为读出链隔离器的芯片级集成替代方案，为可扩展超导量子计算中抑制放大器热噪声提供路径。

title: Assignment maps for arbitrary reduced quantum dynamics
abstract: Given an open quantum system $S$ with environment $E$, we establish a one-to-one correspondence between completely positive trace-preserving (CPTP) maps from $S$ to $E$ and assignment maps initializing the composite system $SE$ in a possibly correlated state prior to unitary evolution. We show that every possible joint state $\rho_{SE}$ can be realized by such assignment maps, which are inherently Hermiticity-preserving and trace-preserving (HPTP). While these maps sacrifice global positivity, we derive a simple necessary and sufficient condition for any local state of $S$ to belong to their domain of validity. Furthermore, we prove that the geometry of this domain is governed by the joint state assigned to the maximally mixed input, ensuring that a non-zero volume of admissible local states can readily coexist with initial system-environment entanglement. Finally, we provide an operational protocol for witnessing such limits of validity.
summary:
1. 该工作建立了从系统到环境的完全正保迹映射与在酉演化前以可能关联的联合态初始化复合系统的指派映射之间的一一对应，并证明任意联合态均可由保厄米保迹的指派映射实现。
2. 其核心是以放弃全局正定性换取对任意关联初态的覆盖，给出局域态落入有效域的充要条件，并证明该域几何由最大混输入所赋联合态决定，使初始系统-环境纠缠与非零体积的可容许局域态共存。
3. 作者进一步给出见证有效域边界的操作协议，为关联初态下开放系统约化动力学的建模、验证与实验检验提供了可操作框架。

title: Choi-Jamiołkowski isomorphism(s) and channel/state duality, naturally!
abstract: Provided a maximally entangled state vector in ${\mathcal{H}}\otimes{\mathcal{H}}$, the Choi-Jamiolkowski isomorphism of quantum information theory (or channel/state duality) produces a mapping of ${\mathsf CP}({\mathcal{H}},{\mathcal{K}})$ (completely positive maps of density operators on ${\mathcal{H}}$ tothose on ${\mathcal{K}}$) onto the density operators on ${\mathcal{K}}\otimes{\mathcal{H}}$, which extends to a unitary map. Here, ${\mathcal{H}}$ and ${\mathcal{K}}$ are {finite-dimensional} Hilbert this http URL nature of this construction, the form of the associated formulas, and the possibility of versions which do not require an entangled vector seed, are illuminated from the perspective of {naturality}, in the sense of Eilenberg and this http URL is a unique such correspondence (``Choi map'') natural in both ${\mathcal{H}}$ and ${\mathcal{K}}$ which produces density operators on either ${\mathsf L}({\mathcal{H}},{\mathcal{K}})$ (Hilbert-Schmidt inner product) or ${\mathcal{K}}\otimes{\mathcal{H}}^*$ instead of ${\mathcal{K}}\otimes{\mathcal{H}}$. In particular, no entangled state input is required. There are no such binatural maps carried on ${\mathcal{K}}\otimes{\mathcal{H}}$, but those natural in only ${\mathcal{K}}$ are canonically associated with unitary maps ${\mathcal{H}}\rightarrow{\mathcal{H}}^*$ and derive from the binatural maps. The construction recovers the standard Choi-Jamiolkowski formulae and shows how they express naturality.
summary:
1. 该文从范畴论自然性视角重审Choi–Jamiołkowski同构与信道/态对偶，构造并刻画无需纠缠态种子的自然Choi映射。
2. 其核心卖点是证明在H与K上双自然、取值于L(H,K)（希尔伯特-施密特内积）或K⊗H*的Choi映射唯一，而K⊗H上不存在双自然映射；仅对K自然者则由H→H*的酉映射规范导出。
3. 这澄清了标准Choi–Jamiołkowski公式如何表达自然性，并为不依赖最大纠缠参考态的态-信道对偶提供了范畴论表述框架。

title: Quantum algorithm for high-dimensional nonlinear stochastic differential equations based on Carleman linearization
abstract: Addressing nonlinear numerical problems in quantum computing remains challenging, but several approaches, including Carleman linearization (CL), have been proposed to construct quantum algorithms for such problems. In this work, we develop a CL-based method for a high-dimensional nonlinear stochastic differential equation (SDE) $\mathrm{d} \mathbf{X}_t = \left(A(t) \mathbf{X}_t + F(t) \mathbf{X}_t^{\otimes s}\right) \mathrm{d} t + B(t) \mathrm{d} \mathbf{W}_t$ for an $\mathbb{R}^N$-valued random process $\mathbf{X}_t$, aiming at quantum speed-up with respect to the dimension $N$. We introduce auxiliary processes $\mathbf{Y}^j_t$ that approximate $\mathbf{X}_t^{\otimes j}$, derive a linearized system of SDEs for them, and obtain the linear ordinary differential equation (ODE) governing their expectations. We then apply a quantum ODE solver to it and, from the resulting quantum state, extract an estimate for the expectation of a linear function of $\mathbf{X}_t$ by overlap estimation. We show that, provided the nonlinear and noise terms in the SDE are sufficiently small relative to the linear term, the CL error decreases exponentially with the truncation order $J$ in CL, and we can estimate the target expectation with a ${\rm polylog}(N)$ number of queries to unitaries encoding coefficient matrices $A$, $F$, and $B$. Finally, we also run a numerical demonstration for an SDE related to Langevin dynamics, observing the exponential decay of the CL error as $J$ increases.
summary:
1. 该工作构建了基于Carleman线性化的量子算法，用于求解高维非线性随机微分方程，并通过引入逼近随机过程张量幂的辅助过程、线性化随机微分方程及其期望满足的线性常微分方程，结合量子常微分方程求解器和重叠估计来估计线性函数的期望。
2. 其核心卖点是在非线性项与噪声项相对线性项足够小时，Carleman截断误差随截断阶数指数衰减，且对编码系数矩阵的幺正操作仅需关于维度的多对数级查询次数。
3. 该结果给出了高维非线性随机动力学获得量子加速的一条可检验路径，Langevin动力学相关数值演示对截断误差指数衰减的支持也为其向更广泛随机模型推广提供了启发。

title: Quantum Cryptanalysis on Two Feistel-Type Constructions
abstract: With the rapid advancement of quantum computing, the security of traditional cryptographic systems is facing significant challenges. As a fundamental component of symmetric cryptography, block ciphers have attracted increasing attention regarding their quantum security in recent years. In this paper, we propose new quantum attacks on two Feistel-type constructions, i.e., New Structure IV and the lightweight block cipher LBlock, under the quantum chosen-plaintext attack (qCPA) model. First, we construct an 8-round quantum distinguisher for New Structure IV and perform an $r(r>12)$-round quantum key-recovery attack. Compared with Li et al.'s qCPA-based result presented at INSCRYPT 2024, our attack reduces the time complexity by a factor of $2^{n/2}$, where $n$ denotes the subkey length. Second, we design a 9-round quantum distinguisher for LBlock and extend it to an $r(r>15)$-round quantum key-recovery attack. The proposed quantum distinguisher covers one more round than Liu et al.'s automated-search distinguisher at ASIACRYPT 2025, which results in a $2^{16}$ reduction in the time complexity of our $r$-round quantum key-recovery attack on LBlock. Furthermore, by analyzing the structure of the round function and the key scheduling of LBlock, we reduce the subkey guess space for the 15-round attack from 76 bits to 52 bits, lowering the time complexity from \(O(2^{38})\) to \(O(2^{26})\) by a factor of \(2^{12}\).
summary:
1. 该文在量子选择明文攻击模型下，对New Structure IV与轻量级分组密码LBlock提出新的量子密钥恢复攻击，分别构造8轮和9轮量子区分器并扩展至12轮以上和15轮以上。
2. 其卖点是New Structure IV攻击的时间复杂度较INSCRYPT 2024结果降低2^{n/2}，LBlock区分器较ASIACRYPT 2025自动搜索结果多覆盖一轮，使r轮攻击复杂度降低2^{16}。
3. 通过分析LBlock轮函数与密钥编排，15轮攻击的子密钥猜测空间由76比特降至52比特、复杂度由O(2^{38})降至O(2^{26})，显示结构化密钥空间约简可显著提升量子密码分析效率。

title: Collision-aware Bayesian mitigation of photon loss in linear optical quantum circuits
abstract: Photon loss is the dominant noise source in linear optical quantum circuits. Each lost photon turns an ideal n-photon outcome into a pattern with fewer photons, so the detector counts no longer follow the ideal output distribution, and the lossless events that do follow it become exponentially rare as the photon number grows. Discarding the lossy events (postselection) therefore wastes most of the data at realistic loss rates, and the ideal distribution has to be inferred from the lossy counts themselves. Recycling-based mitigation (Mills & Mezher, Quantum 2026; Quandela's photon_recycling) reweights lossy samples to recover lossless probabilities, but its estimators are biased and restricted to the no-collision sector, where each output mode holds at most one photon. We instead treat the raw counts as Multinomial observations under per-photon binomial loss and infer the ideal output distribution and the loss rate jointly from a Bayesian posterior, which extends naturally to outputs with collisions. On data from the independent Perceval simulator at the scale of prior work (n=4 photons in m=20 and m=10 modes), the posterior has lower KL divergence than both recycling and postselection at every tested loss rate in the no-collision benchmark. In the collision regime it recovers the loss rate and the collision-pattern probabilities, which recycling cannot estimate, and stays below recycling at every loss rate and below postselection except at low loss, where the two are comparable. Its advantage over recycling grows with the sample count, and it supplies credible intervals that the baselines lack.
summary:
1. 该工作提出碰撞感知的贝叶斯方法，将线性光学电路原始计数视为逐光子二项损失下的多项分布观测，并从后验联合推断理想输出分布与损耗率。
2. 其核心卖点是突破回收法仅限无碰撞扇区且有偏的限制，可自然处理多光子碰撞输出，并在相同规模模拟数据上以更低KL散度优于回收和后选择，同时给出可信区间。
3. 这为真实损耗条件下的线性光学量子线路提供可量化不确定度的分布重构途径，并提示在碰撞显著的场景中联合推断损耗与输出统计更具信息效率。

title: Microscopic Bipartition and Macroscopic Symmetry in a Rényi Entanglement Ensemble
abstract: Universal information extracted from entanglement at a critical point is commonly associated with the long-distance properties of the bulk state, while microscopic details of a lattice bipartition are expected to be washed out under coarse graining. Counterintuitively, we show directly that such microscopic information can survive in the statistical ensemble that determines the second Rényi entropy and obviously change the physics there. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the square-lattice $J$-$Q_3$ model at the Néel--valence-bond-solid (VBS) transition, we measure magnetic and dimer order parameters in the Rényi-2 ensemble. For a standard axis-aligned bipartition, the VBS component perpendicular to the entanglement boundary remains finite in the thermodynamic extrapolation and is inequivalent to the parallel component, while the Néel order vanishes. For a $45^\circ$ tilted bipartition, in contrast, the two VBS components remain equivalent within numerical accuracy. We interpret this contrast in terms of the Rényi twist defect: the two bipartitions have the same bulk theory but realize different microscopic defect symmetries. Our results demonstrate that lattice information invisible to the bulk continuum theory alone can remain active in the long-distance Rényi ensemble, providing a microscopic explanation for the strong bipartition dependence previously observed in entanglement studies of deconfined criticality.
summary:
1. 该工作用平方晶格J-Q3模型的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，在Néel–VBS转变点测量轴对齐与45°倾斜二分下的Rényi-2系综磁性与二聚化序参量。
2. 其关键发现是微观二分信息未被粗粒化抹去：轴对齐时垂直于纠缠边界的VBS分量在热力学外推中保持有限且与平行分量不等价、Néel序消失，而45°倾斜二分下两VBS分量在数值精度内等价，作者以相同体理论但不同微观缺陷对称性的Rényi扭曲缺陷解释该对比。
3. 这表明仅靠体连续理论不可见的晶格信息仍可在长距离Rényi系综中起作用，为去禁闭临界纠缠研究中观察到的强二分依赖性提供微观解释，并提示需显式追踪缺陷对称性。

title: Stabilizer Rényi moments beyond entanglement
abstract: Stabilizer Rényi moments depend on a choice of operator basis and need not be determined by entanglement spectra. In this paper, we study their spatial decay in critical quantum chains described by two-dimensional conformal field theories. We derive an exact entanglement baseline for reductions of pure stabilizer states and a symmetry selection rule for the charged contribution at fixed support. An exact Ising example shows that an on-site rotation changes the full decay exponent while preserving every subsystem entanglement spectrum. For growing Ising intervals at index two, we obtain an exact Pfaffian representation and compare the charged amplitude with a candidate conformal boundary calculation. The data support this prediction, but its identification with the lattice limit still requires endpoint matching and control of the order of limits.
summary:
1. 该文研究由二维共形场论描述的一维临界量子链中稳定子Rényi矩的空间衰减，并给出纯稳定子态约化密度的精确纠缠基线与固定支撑下荷贡献的对称性选择定则。
2. 其关键卖点是通过精确Ising实例表明局域单点旋转可在保持所有子系统纠缠谱不变的同时改变整体衰减指数，并在指标为二的增长区间给出精确Pfaffian表示以检验共形边界预言。
3. 这些结果说明稳定子Rényi矩包含超出纠缠谱的信息，但其共形边界解释仍需端点匹配并控制极限次序，才能与晶格极限严格对应。

title: Multimode Parametric Amplifier for K-Band Quantum Measurements
abstract: We demonstrate K-band nondegenerate three-wave-mixing amplification in a multimode resonator comprising an array of 500 SNAILs. Pairing K-band signal modes with lower-frequency internal idler modes enables 20 dB of gain continuously from 19.6 to 25.6 GHz with pump frequencies below 32.2 GHz. At 20 dB gain, the 3-dB bandwidth ranges from 2.6 to 11.7 MHz, and the input-referred 1-dB compression power reaches -100.9 dBm. In the 20-22 GHz band, the average added noise is 0.73 quanta. A two-mode nondegenerate parametric amplification model describes the measured gain response and gain-bandwidth behavior, while a multimode Kerr model captures the overall compression scale. Our amplifier provides a practical solution for implementing a state-of-the-art readout of superconducting qubits in the K-band.
summary:
1. 该工作基于500个SNAIL组成的多模谐振腔，演示了K波段的非简并三波混频参量放大。
2. 其核心是将K波段信号模与低频内部闲频模配对，在泵浦低于32.2 GHz时于19.6–25.6 GHz连续实现20 dB增益，20 dB增益下3 dB带宽为2.6–11.7 MHz、输入1 dB压缩点达−100.9 dBm，20–22 GHz平均附加噪声0.73量子，并以双模非简并参量放大模型解释增益-带宽行为、多模Kerr模型刻画压缩尺度。
3. 该器件为在K波段实现超导量子比特的先进读出提供了实用方案。

title: Bidirectional Path Integral Monte Carlo Simulation of Quantum Circuits
abstract: We propose an approximate classical algorithm for estimating quantum circuits' transition amplitudes, $\langle \Psi_f | \hat{U} | \Psi_0 \rangle$, based on Monte Carlo sums over bidirectionally sampled Feynman paths. The algorithm generates Feynman paths, i.e., sequences of intermediate computational basis states, by combining information from random walks initiated at both the input and output states, $\Psi_0$ and $\Psi_f$, respectively. It further combines this bidirectional approach with Multiple Importance Sampling, a powerful variance reduction technique that avoids variance peaks caused by divisions by the very low sampling probabilities associated with hard to reach paths. Empirical data demonstrate the superior convergence rate exhibited by the bidirectional algorithm over a unidirectional, forward-only sampling approach. This superiority is due to the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in finding and weighting paths with non-zero amplitude in an extremely sparse path space. Sum of paths algorithms exhibit very favourable space complexity. Monte Carlo replaces exhaustive enumeration of the exponentially large path space by stochastic sampling, the computational cost being determined by the variance of the estimator. This work demonstrates these two features by presenting results on very large quantum circuits, with up to 4096 qubits.
summary:
1. 该工作提出一种基于双向采样费曼路径蒙特卡罗求和的经典近似算法，用于估计量子电路跃迁振幅，并给出高达4096量子比特电路上的实证结果。
2. 其核心卖点在于将从输入态和输出态同时出发的路径采样与多重重要性采样结合，降低难达路径低采样概率导致的方差尖峰，在极稀疏路径空间中比单向前向采样更快收敛且保持有利空间复杂度。
3. 这表明以估计量方差为计算成本、用随机采样替代指数路径枚举的路径求和框架，可为大规模量子电路振幅的经典近似评估提供可扩展思路，但其精度与开销仍受方差控制。

title: Fates of Exact Finite-$N$ First-Order Transitions: Coherent Suppression versus Spectral-Collapse Termination
abstract: Symmetry-protected ground-state crossings can produce exact first-order transitions (FOTs) even at finite $N$, in contrast to continuous transitions governed by soft-mode criticality. We establish exact Juddian ground-state crossings for arbitrary finite $N$ in the one- and two-photon anisotropic Dicke models and identify a common two-channel structure: the eigenvalues of the coupling matrix set the local normal-state instability thresholds, whereas its determinant fixes the exact crossing. Despite this common structure, the resulting FOTs have distinct fates determined by the bosonic response. In the one-photon model, the overlap between coherent Juddian branches vanishes in the thermodynamic or infinite frequency-ratio limits, asymptotically suppressing the FOT cusp. In the two-photon model, squeezed Juddian states lose normalizability at spectral collapse, thereby terminating the physical FOT line at finite $N$. Although the cusp strength tends to zero as the endpoint is approached, the terminating FOT retains a collective spectral signature: the different-parity gap is predicted to close with an $N$-dependent exponent $\mu_N=(2N+3)/4$, one greater than the cusp termination exponent. By contrast, the same-parity soft mode retains $N$-independent square-root scaling and governs the critical response. Thus spectral collapse can terminate an exact finite-$N$ FOT while preserving its collective imprint in the parity-resolved spectrum.
summary:
1. 该工作在单光子和双光子各向异性Dicke模型中构造任意有限N的精确Juddian基态交叉，并比较相干抑制与谱坍缩终止两类精确有限N一阶相变结局。
2. 其卖点在于揭示本征值定失稳阈值、行列式决定精确交叉的两通道结构，并表明单光子相干支重叠消失渐近压制尖点，而双光子压缩态在谱坍缩处失去可归一性并终止有限N相变线。
3. 这预示谱坍缩可终止精确有限N一阶相变却保留宇称分辨谱印记：异宇称能隙按N依赖指数μ_N=(2N+3)/4闭合，同宇称软模仍保持与N无关的平方根标度并主导临界响应。

title: Trapped-ion-based quantum repeater node across a 17 km metropolitan fiber
abstract: Concatenation of quantum repeater nodes has been proposed as a means to distribute entanglement efficiently across future long-distance networks. Here, we demonstrate a trapped-ion repeater node that establishes photonic entanglement over a 17 km fiber traversing a city, moving beyond laboratory-only prototypes. The node comprises two atomic ions coupled to an optical cavity. First, a detailed characterization is performed of the long fiber channel and of ion-photon entanglement distributed across it. Next, a repeater-node protocol is implemented, achieving entanglement between a local photon and a remote photon with a Bell-state fidelity of $81.6^{+1.9}_{-1.4}\%$. These results demonstrate that trapped-ion repeater-node technology can operate over existing city-scale fiber infrastructure and represent a step toward distributed quantum repeater networks.
summary:
1. 该工作在贯穿城市的17公里光纤上演示了由两个与光学腔耦合的囚禁离子构成的量子中继节点，并在表征长距离信道与离子-光子纠缠后实现了中继节点协议。
2. 其技术要点是在现有城域光纤基础设施上建立本地光子与远端光子的纠缠，测得Bell态保真度为$81.6^{+1.9}_{-1.4}\%$，而非仅限实验室原型。
3. 这表明囚禁离子中继节点技术可运行于实际城市级光纤链路，为构建分布式量子中继网络迈出可验证的一步。

title: Sparse block encoding with low subnormalisation for quantum linear solvers on unstructured meshes
abstract: Unstructured meshes are widely used in modelling and simulation in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) due to their geometric flexibility. However, they require an efficient block encoding circuit describing the system. Here, we present a new block encoding methodology for unstructured mesh solvers based on decomposing the system matrix into a sum of 1-sparse matrices. This block encoding is engineered to reduce subnormalisation even in the absence of structure by hiding the contribution of large matrix elements behind others. We investigate three methods of 1-sparse decomposition. Our circuit constructions can optionally take advantage of limited matrix bandwidth and repeated values. For example we consider digitisation (reduced precision), where the number of multiplexed rotation gates is equal to the number of non-unique matrix entries. We evaluate our methodologies using 2D and 3D CFD matrices for unstructured aerofoil meshes, structured cavity, and duct meshes, with and without matrix preconditioning. Our results show that we are able to achieve a block encoding with a near constant subnormalisation factor as the number of matrix preconditioning infill levels increases. This significantly reduces the subnormalised condition number and, in one case, reduces the degree of the QSP polynomial approximation to $1/x$ by 100,000. Reduced precision digitisation is shown to become more effective as the number of preconditioning infill levels is increased and, in one case, reduces the number of multiplexed rotations from 2,785,576 to 546 whilst maintaining an infidelity of $2.6\times10^{-5}$ relative to the classical solution. The effect of digitisation on QSVT solutions is demonstrated using 2D and 3D unstructured mesh aerofoil cases. Due to its flexibility and automatic applicability, we believe our 1-sparse decomposition block encoding can offer benefits to other quantum applications.
summary:
1. 该工作提出基于1-稀疏矩阵求和的块编码方法，用于非结构网格量子线性求解器，并在二维/三维CFD网格上比较三种分解方案。
2. 其关键是在无结构时隐藏大幅值矩阵元以压低子归一化，并利用有限带宽、重复值和降精度数字化，使预处理填充增加时子归一化因子近乎恒定并显著降低条件数。
3. 该框架可自动用于非结构网格求解并有望推广至其他量子应用；一例中数字化将多路复用旋转门从2785576降至546，且QSP多项式次数降低100000。

title: Constant-Depth Quantum Barrier Option Pricing via a Static Bivariate Oracle Framework
abstract: Quantum amplitude estimation offers a theoretical quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo methods for financial derivative pricing. However, extending gate-based algorithms to path-dependent barrier options has historically been hampered by sequential path discretization, where tracking price paths across $d$ monitoring dates incurs a linear escalation in qubit footprint and gate depth ($\mathcal{O}(d)$), posing severe coherence challenges for near-term quantum processors. In this work, we present a constant-depth quantum pricing framework that fundamentally eliminates the temporal dependency of barrier monitoring. Leveraging the Brownian reflection principle and Girsanov theorem, we project the continuous supremum dynamics onto a static bivariate joint distribution of the terminal price $S_T$ and running supremum $M_T$. This allows decoupling dynamic boundary checks into a static bivariate oracle comprising two parallel comparators and a dual-controlled rotation gate. We prove this architecture reduces circuit depth and comparator complexity from $\mathcal{O}(d)$ to an invariant $\mathcal{O}(1)$, while supporting discrete monitoring via zero-quantum-cost boundary corrections. Transpilation benchmarks for daily monitoring ($d = 252$) show our framework slashes physical CNOT count by 98.59% (from 2262 to 32) and compresses two-qubit depth by 98.02% (from 1514 to 30 layers). Under a realistic 127-qubit IBM Eagle noise model, the shallow circuit achieves a 7.84% relative valuation error with M3 readout mitigation. Finally, the framework seamlessly extends to nonlinear exotic payoffs lacking analytical solutions, establishing a noise-resilient pathway toward practical quantum advantage in computational finance.
summary:
1. 该工作提出静态双变量预言机框架，以常数深度量子电路定价路径依赖障碍期权，将连续上确界动力学投影为终端价格与运行上确界的联合分布。
2. 其技术核心是用布朗反射原理与 Girsanov 定理把动态边界监测解耦为两个并行比较器和双控旋转门，使电路深度与比较器复杂度由 O(d) 降为 O(1)，并以零量子成本边界修正支持离散监测。
3. 日频监测转译将 CNOT 数由 2262 降至 32，127 比特噪声模型下相对误差 7.84%，为非线性奇异收益定价提供噪声韧性路径。

title: Cooling more while dissipating less: anomalous tradeoffs from thermodynamic geometry
abstract: We show that, starting from the same state, optimal driving can sometimes reach a colder (or hotter) target in the same amount of time while dissipating less energy, or equivalently dissipate the same amount of energy in a shorter time. We study this counterintuitive phenomenon in the slow-driving regime of an open quantum system, where we name it Near-Equilibrium Anomalous Tradeoff (NEAT). We establish necessary conditions for its occurrence and show its underlying geometric origin. While NEAT is reminiscent of the well-known Mpemba effect, the two phenomena are distinct in general. We demonstrate NEAT in an exactly solvable qutrit model, as well as for d-dimensional birth-death dynamics with independently controlled energy levels. Finally, we show how NEAT can improve the performance of Carnot engines.
summary:
1. 该工作在开放量子系统慢驱动区提出并刻画“近平衡反常权衡”（NEAT）：从同一初态出发，最优驱动可在相同时间内达到更冷或更热目标且耗散更少，或以更短时间完成同等耗散。
2. 其核心在于给出NEAT发生的必要条件并揭示其热力学几何起源，说明其与Mpemba效应一般不同，并在可解qutrit模型及能级独立控制的d维生灭动力学中验证。
3. 这一机制可提升卡诺热机性能，并为有限时间热力学中同时优化冷却与耗散提供几何判据与设计启发。

title: The Fer expansion of a driven spin under $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ operations cannot terminate beyond first order
abstract: The Fer expansion writes the propagator of a driven quantum system as an ordered product of exponentials, each generated by the time integral of an effective Hamiltonian that governs the evolution left over by the previous factors. It can be stopped after finitely many factors whenever this leftover evolution is known in closed form, for instance when the effective Hamiltonian commutes with itself at all times, or precesses about a fixed axis with constant angular velocity. For $\mathfrak{su}(2)$, in any representation, from a qubit to a spin of any size, we resum the Fer recursion into a closed map on curves in $\mathbb{R}^3$. We prove that, for a real-analytic drive, in both cases the expansion stops beyond the first factor only trivially, when the first exponential is already exact.
summary:
1. 该工作把任意表示下受驱su(2)自旋的Fer展开递归重求和为ℝ^3中曲线上的闭映射，并据此检验该展开能否在有限阶终止。
2. 其核心结论是：对实解析驱动，在有效哈密顿量始终对易或绕固定轴以恒定角速度进动两类情形下，除第一因子外仅有平凡终止，即首个指数已精确成立。
3. 这提示对一般驱动su(2)体系不宜期待Fer展开的高阶截断，并为传播子的精确求解与数值方案选择提供了明确边界。

title: Phase shifts and fluctuations from motional, relativistic, and dark-matter effects in ion-trap clocks
abstract: Ions possess both center-of-mass motion and internal states, rendering trapped-ion optical clocks susceptible to perturbations of both degrees of freedom, which results in systematic shifts and fluctuations with motional and relativistic origins. We develop a quantum theory that connects these effects to filter functions determined by the employed pulse sequences and show how the interrogation can be tailored to suppress or enhance specific perturbations. Our treatment includes laser frequency noise and motional effects such as recoil and Doppler shifts, micromotion and excess micromotion, as well as state-dependent trap imperfections and accelerations, e.g., caused by Stark shifts.
