We further account for relativistic effects including time dilation and the mass defect, and show how the same framework can be applied to hypothetical dark-matter signals. By considering ensemble-averaged phases and their variances, we characterize both systematic shifts and fluctuations, while asynchronous operation relative to the Paul-trap drive allows motional fluctuations to average down between runs. Our results provide a unified framework for characterizing and controlling the systematic and statistical contributions that determine the trueness and precision of trapped-ion optical clocks.
summary:
1. 该工作建立了连接离子运动、相对论效应及暗物质信号同脉冲序列滤波函数的量子理论，用以刻画囚禁离子光钟的相位移动与涨落。
2. 其核心是通过裁剪询问脉冲序列选择性抑制或增强激光频率噪声、反冲、多普勒与微运动、态依赖陷阱误差及加速度等扰动，并统一纳入时间膨胀、质量亏损和暗物质响应。
3. 结合系综平均相位与方差并利用相对保罗阱驱动异步操作压低运行间运动涨落，该框架为控制囚禁离子光钟准确度与稳定度提供了统一描述。

title: Relativistic Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect
abstract: The Unruh effect links acceleration to thermalization, providing a relativistic setting for anomalous quantum relaxation. We demonstrate a {\it relativistic} strong quantum Mpemba effect in the Unruh thermalization of a two-level detector coupled to a massless scalar field. For a fixed pair of isospectral initial states, relaxation curves that never cross in inertial motion exhibit a Mpemba crossing above a threshold acceleration. At a higher, precisely tuned acceleration, the initially farther state has zero overlap with the slowest decay mode and relaxes with a faster asymptotic exponential rate. We identify how competition between transition and dephasing channels governs the relaxation spectrum, where sufficiently strong longitudinal coupling enables acceleration to switch the relaxation bottleneck between population and coherence modes. We derive the spectral-switching condition and construct isospectral preparation protocols that eliminate slow-mode contributions within their physical domains. These protocols reveal how coherence can suppress or enhance slow-mode overlap at fixed purity, depending on the underlying spectral structure. Our results establish acceleration as a control parameter for anomalous quantum relaxation, connecting relativistic quantum dynamics with nonequilibrium thermodynamics.
summary:
1. 该工作研究耦合无质量标量场的二能级探测器在Unruh热化中的相对论性强量子Mpemba效应，发现固定一对等谱初态时，超过阈值加速度可令惯性系中永不相交的弛豫曲线发生Mpemba交叉。
2. 其核心在于阐明跃迁与退相干通道竞争决定弛豫谱，并在精确调谐的更高加速度下使初始更远态与最慢衰减模式零重叠、获得更快渐近指数衰减，同时给出谱切换条件及等谱制备协议。
3. 这将加速度确立为异常量子弛豫的可控参数，并把相对论量子动力学与非平衡热力学联系起来，为在相关平台检验相干性对慢模重叠的调控提供启发。

title: Optimal Quantum-Circuit Synthesis and Implementation of General Unitaries with Parallelized Bitstring-Conditioned Rotations
abstract: We theoretically introduce a quantum-circuit synthesis protocol to realize any $n$-qubit transformation $U\in U(2^n)$, up to a diagonal. The resulting circuit is directly native to and optimal in gate count and depth for systems where bitstring-conditioned rotations with tunable angle and axis, $C^{(n-1)}R(\theta,\phi)$, form the set of native operations. Subsequently, we suggest how this protocol can be implemented in a few-mode superconducting circuit, and experimentally demonstrate the method for the smallest nontrivial case, i.e., for two qubits. We report an average gate fidelity of 97.6 % for Haar-random two-qubit unitaries up to phase shifts in the computational basis. Importantly, these results suggest that multimode devices, such as those in the multimon or multiunimon families may become competitive with qubit-array networks for general-unitary implementations for qubit counts as low as three.
summary:
1. 该工作提出一种将任意 \(n\) 比特幺正变换（至多相差一个对角项）编译为比特串条件旋转 \(C^{(n-1)}R(\theta,\phi)\) 的量子电路合成协议，并在少模超导电路中完成两比特实验验证。
2. 其核心卖点是在该类原生门集合下同时达到门数与深度最优，且两比特 Haar 随机幺正的实验平均保真度达 97.6%（忽略计算基相位）。
3. 这表明多模超导器件（如 multimon/multiunimon 家族）在低至三比特时有望与量子比特阵列网络竞争通用幺正实现。

title: A $q$-Inspired Radial Quantum Kinematics
abstract: We study how the one-dimensional deformation suggested by nonadditive $q$-calculus can be extended to a rotationally covariant quantum model and what observable consequences follow from this extension. We choose a radial extension about a distinguished center in which only the radial derivative is deformed, while tangential derivatives retain their ordinary form. Within this model, we construct self-adjoint frame-momentum operators and derive a rotationally invariant uncertainty bound with a correction proportional to the mean distance from the center. We then adopt a non-negative kinetic Hamiltonian built from these momenta and derive the leading harmonic-oscillator energy shifts for weak deformation. The energy corrections split the levels with different orbital angular momenta that are degenerate in the undeformed oscillator, while preserving the degeneracy associated with rotational symmetry.
summary:
1. 该工作将非加性q微积分启发的一维形变推广为以特定中心为原点的旋转协变径向量子模型，仅形变径向导数而保持切向导数不变。
2. 其核心在于构造自伴框架动量算符并给出含平均径向距离修正的旋转不变不确定度下界，同时在弱形变下得到非负动能哈密顿量导致的谐振子能级移动。
3. 该结果使未形变谐振子中不同轨道角动量的简并发生分裂而保留旋转对称简并，为检验径向q形变提供可观测的能谱判据。

title: Dimension-free marginal inequalities for pure three-party states
abstract: The quantum marginal problem, concerned with the compatibility of local and global properties of a multipartite quantum system, is arguably one of the fundamental questions in quantum theory. In this article we introduce a novel family of inequalities bounding the allowed local spectra of a pure tripartite state. The number of inequalities in this family grows with the dimension of the system. Most importantly, the inequalities hold for arbitrary dimensions. For equal local dimension at most 4, they generate the complete set of eigenvalue inequalities.
summary:
1. 该工作针对纯三体量子态的量子边缘问题，提出并系统研究了一类约束其可允许局域谱的新不等式族。
2. 其核心卖点是不等式数量随系统维数增长却对任意局域维数均成立，且在三个局域维数相等且不超过4时，该族生成完整的特征值不等式集合，从而在低维等维情形给出完备刻画。
3. 这为纯三体态局域谱的完整刻画提供了维数无关的约束框架，并可能启发更高维及更一般多体边缘问题中完整不等式集合的构造与判定。

title: Structured light for addressable two-qubit gates in medium-sized ion crystals: modeling motional and dephasing errors
abstract: Geometric phase gates with addressed laser radiation are widely used in trapped-ion quantum computers to drive high-fidelity entangling gates on an arbitrary qubit pair of a larger ion chain. Such programmable connectivity exploits the collective phonons to mediate the desired interaction, while simultaneously achieving robustness to their thermal fluctuations by a careful calibration of the gate time with respect to the laser and vibrational-mode frequencies. Crosstalk errors can arise when the spectator qubits, which should ideally remain idle during the gate, are partially driven by the laser fields. The minimal crosstalk, which is set by the laser beam size on the spectator ions, can be achieved when the addressing beams propagate perpendicular to the ion chain. However, this results in exciting the radial phonons, and can complicate achieving high-fidelities as the ion chain grows due to the so-called spectral mode crowding. In this work, we present the theoretical description of a scheme recently implemented by Faorlin et $al.$. This scheme overcomes these complications by engineering addressable state-dependent forces along the ion-chain with laser beams that propagate perpendicular to it through the use of structured light gradients. In this way, one can excite the axial phonons and avoid the spectral mode crowding, while simultaneously minimizing the crosstalk. We present a detailed derivation of the entangling gate scheme, together with analytical closed-form expressions for the leading contribution to the gate error caused by thermal motional fluctuations and dephasing noise. Our results confirm that such fluctuations account for up to 93$\%$ of the error budget under the operating conditions of the gate implemented by Faorlin et $al.$. We identify target parameters to reduce the motional error from the reported $10^{-3}$ to the $10^{-5}$ level.
summary:
1. 该工作对利用结构化光梯度在中型离子晶体中实现可寻址两比特几何相位门的方案给出理论描述，并推导了热运动涨落与退相位噪声主导的门误差解析表达式。
2. 其技术要点是让寻址激光垂直离子链传播并通过结构化光梯度产生沿链的态依赖力，从而激发轴向声子、规避径向谱模拥挤并压低旁观离子串扰，同时以闭式公式量化误差来源。
3. 在已实现门参数下该模型解释热涨落可占误差预算至93%，并给出将运动误差从10^-3降至10^-5的目标参数，为中等规模离子链的可编程连通性扩展提供依据。

title: Floquet ground state order
abstract: Clean, interacting, periodically driven systems are believed to thermalize to featureless, infinite-temperature states that preclude the formation of stable ordered states. Here, we show stable quantum order, distinct from prethermal order, and its phase transitions in the ground state of the average-energy operator. Decomposing the time evolution into geometric and average-energy dynamics, we apply Geometric Floquet theory to identify the Floquet ground state. We derive a general variational principle to compute the Floquet ground state in large interacting periodically driven systems, and use it to develop a matrix product state algorithm. In driven nonintegrable chains of more than 100 interacting spins, our numerical simulations exhibit a gapped, area-law entangled Floquet ground state in extended parameter regimes; the ground-state manifold can support both dressed equilibrium order (e.g., Floquet antiferromagnets) and inherently nonequilibrium order (e.g., ground-state time crystals). This quantum order is protected by a finite average-energy gap, which closes at phase transition points upon changing model parameters. We decompose Floquet phases of matter into their equilibrium and nonequilibrium elements: whereas the Floquet ground state at any fixed time is a representative of an equilibrium phase of matter, the nonequilibrium content is entirely produced by the drive holonomy and is geometric. Finally, we identify quasilocal counterdiabatic driving as a mechanism for the stability against heating of gapped Floquet ground states in nonintegrable quantum systems, and argue why Floquet ground states evade the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis. Our work enables the study of interacting nonequilibrium matter deep into the many-body regime, and lays the foundations for the engineering of strongly correlated ordered quantum states.
summary:
1. 该工作以平均能量算符的基态定义Floquet基态序，用几何Floquet理论与变分原理构建矩阵乘积态算法，并在逾百自旋的驱动非可积链中求解。
2. 其卖点是展示区别于预热化的稳定量子序：有能隙、面积律纠缠的Floquet基态可承载修饰平衡序（如Floquet反铁磁）与本征非平衡序（如基态时间晶体），相变由平均能量能隙闭合标定。
3. 该工作将Floquet物相拆分为平衡代表与驱动和乐产生的几何非平衡内容，并给出准局域反绝热驱动抑制加热的机制，为多体非平衡物相与强关联有序态工程奠定基础。

title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits
abstract: Photonic and qubit-based (digital) approaches to quantum computing are largely regarded as separate paradigms. This article aims to bridge these paradigms by developing a method for mapping quantum-optical systems onto qubit-based quantum circuits. The key ingredient enabling this mapping is the introduction of a truncation of the Fock space describing single-mode optical states. Within this framework, representations of basic photonic operations are developed, including the phase-rotation operator, the displacement operator, the squeezing operator, and the beam splitter. Explicit quantum circuit constructions are provided for Fock-space truncations of dimension $N=2$ and $N=4$. We discuss benchmarking of the implemented operations and identify the regime of applicability and the limitations of the proposed method. The presented results can be used to simulate quantum optical circuits on qubit-based quantum computers, with special relevance to Gaussian Boson Sampling in the low-photon-number regime. To demonstrate the practical applicability of this approach, we complement the theoretical framework with a Python-based quantum programming tool CO$\Phi$ that compiles Blackbird quantum-optics programs into qubit-based OpenQASM circuits using a truncated Fock-space encoding. The compiler is available on GitHub at this https URL .
summary:
1. 该工作提出将量子光学系统映射为基于量子比特的数字量子线路的方法，通过截断单模光学态的Fock空间，给出相位旋转、位移、压缩和分束等基本光子操作的表示，并为N=2和N=4截断提供显式线路及基准测试。
2. 其关键技术卖点是可控的Fock空间截断编码，使Blackbird量子光学程序可由Python工具COΦ编译为OpenQASM线路，并在低光子数区间评估适用性与局限。
3. 这为在量子比特平台上模拟光子线路、特别是低光子数高斯玻色采样提供了可操作路径，同时明确了该映射方法的适用范围与后续扩展需求。

title: Capturing Open Quantum System Dynamics with Compact Dressed Hamiltonians
abstract: We advance the compact dressed Hamiltonian (CDH) framework to simulate the dynamics of open quantum systems strongly coupled to structured bosonic environments. The CDH approach combines reaction-coordinate mapping with a polaron transformation, incorporating strong system-environment hybridization into a dressed representation before truncating the collective bosonic mode. As a result of this truncation, dynamical features are captured with substantially fewer states than in the original representation. The residual environment is treated using a weak-coupling Markovian quantum master equation. We benchmark the method for spin-boson-type models including a single spin, coupled spins, and spin ensembles, considering both resonant and off-resonant regimes and weak to strong system-bath coupling. Comparisons with hierarchical equations of motion and converged reaction-coordinate calculations demonstrate that the CDH representation systematically approaches the reference dynamics with a compact Hilbert space, accurately reproducing oscillation frequencies, relaxation behavior, and long-time populations over a broad parameter regime. The method further captures cooperative phenomena, including bath-mediated interactions, synchronization between spins, and signatures for collective emission. Beyond efficient time propagation, the CDH framework provides direct access to the spectrum and eigenmodes of the Liouvillian. We demonstrate that slow dynamical modes converge rapidly in the CDH representation, enabling identification of relaxation timescales without fitting time-dependent observables. As a whole, the CDH framework provides an efficient and physical description of strongly coupled open quantum-system dynamics.
summary:
1. 该工作发展了紧凑缀饰哈密顿量（CDH）框架，将反应坐标映射与极化子变换结合并截断集体玻色模，以模拟强耦合结构化玻色环境中的开放量子系统动力学。
2. 其技术卖点在于截断后的缀饰表示以显著更少的状态重现自旋-玻色模型的振荡频率、弛豫和长时布居，并以弱耦合马尔可夫主方程处理残余环境，同时可直接获取Liouvillian谱与慢模式。
3. 该框架在弱到强系统-浴耦合及共振/非共振区间与HEOM和收敛反应坐标计算一致，并能描述浴介导相互作用、自旋同步和集体发射特征，为高效识别弛豫时间尺度提供物理化途径。

title: Hidden parabolic subgroups of $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over finite chain rings
abstract: We give a bounded-error quantum polynomial-time algorithm for finding hidden parabolic subgroups of $\mathrm{GL}_n(R)$ over any effectively presented finite chain ring $R$. We call auxiliary group elements or subgroups used to extract information through oracle queries \emph{probes}. For chain length at least two, elementary abelian socle probes first recover the complete flag modulo the maximal ideal. When the residue field has size $q\ge3$, we reconstruct the flag recursively, lifting rank-one terminal members one digit at a time. The intermediate digits reduce to abelian hidden subgroup problems, while the final digit is a finite-field multiple-shift problem solved using learning from subset and Fourier sampling. For $q=2$, where distinct flags can have the same stabilizer, we instead lift the conjugate parabolic subgroup through the congruence filtration. A final linear system determines it modulo normalizer directions. The algorithm outputs generators with probability at least $1-\epsilon$ in time $\mathrm{poly}(n,\log|R|,\log(1/\epsilon))$. Consequences include $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})$ for every $N\ge2$ and, with an explicit maximal-order presentation, $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O_K}/N\mathcal{O_K})$ for number fields $K$.
summary:
1. 该工作给出一个在任意有效给出的有限链环 \(R\) 上求 \(\mathrm{GL}_n(R)\) 隐藏抛物子群的有界误差量子多项式时间算法。
2. 其核心是用初等阿贝尔基座探针先恢复模极大理想的完全旗，再逐位提升秩一末端成员：中间位归约为阿贝尔隐藏子群问题，末位用子集学习与傅里叶采样求解有限域多重移位问题；\(q=2\) 时改为沿合同滤过提升共轭抛物子群并用线性系统确定到正规化子方向。
3. 该结果可直接覆盖 \(\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})\)，并在显式极大序表示下覆盖数域 \(K\) 的 \(\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O}_K/N\mathcal{O}_K)\)，为链环上的隐藏子群型量子算法提供了可推广框架。

title: Stable charged energy and phase transitions in an anisotropic Dicke quantum battery with Kerr nonlinearity
abstract: Phase transitions (PTs) in quantum many-body systems offer a powerful route to manipulate the performance of quantum batteries (QBs). Here, we investigate an anisotropic Dicke QB with Kerr nonlinearity, focusing on the role of PTs in the charging process of the QB system. By analyzing how the Kerr nonlinearity reshapes the cavity level-spacing structure, we find that multiple near-degeneracies emerge at specific nonlinearity strengths. Away from the region of multiple near-degeneracies, the stable stored energy is governed primarily by the ergodic-nonergodic transition (ENET), whereas within this region it is controlled by first- and second-order dissipative phase transitions (DPTs). We employ Liouvillian spectral theory to quantify the critical slowing down associated with the DPTs, and use the Wigner function to characterize the properties of the cavity field in the vicinity of criticality. We optimize the charging process via reinforcement learning (RL) and reveal the physical mechanism underlying performance enhancement from the perspective of ergodic and nonergodic phase dynamics. Our results offer a feasible pathway for manipulating and optimizing quantum battery performance based on intrinsic PT behaviors.
summary:
1. 该工作构建了含克尔非线性的各向异性迪克量子电池模型，系统考察相变在充电过程中的作用，并分析非线性如何重塑腔场能级间距及产生多重近简并。
2. 其核心卖点在于区分了两类调控机制：远离多重近简并区时稳定储能主要由遍历-非遍历转变决定，而在该区域内则由一阶与二阶耗散相变控制，并用刘维尔谱理论量化临界慢化、用维格纳函数刻画临界腔场。
3. 结合强化学习优化充电并联系遍历与非遍历相动力学的分析，为利用本征相变行为操控与优化量子电池性能提供了可操作路径。

title: Chaos and scrambling in anisotropic Dicke and Rabi models
abstract: Identifying the quantum signatures of classical chaos remains a central question in quantum physics, and quantum scrambling provides a new perspective on this correspondence. We study two distinct limits of the same model to examine how the correspondence between chaos and scrambling changes across different regimes. The thermodynamic-limit anisotropic Dicke model exhibits a close correspondence between chaos and scrambling, whereas this correspondence breaks down in the large-frequency-ratio limit of the anisotropic Rabi model (ARM). The contrasting chaotic behavior in the two limits originates from the different numbers of classical degrees of freedom, whereas their similar scrambling behavior stems from eigenstate delocalization. This implies that, in the large-frequency-ratio limit, eigenstate delocalization alone is insufficient to qualify the ARM as a classically chaotic model. This finding suggests that identifying chaos in quantum systems requires jointly considering the classical degrees of freedom and eigenstate delocalization.
summary:
1. 该工作通过比较同一各向异性模型的Dicke热力学极限与Rabi大频率比极限，考察经典混沌与量子扰乱之间的对应关系。
2. 其核心结果是：Dicke极限中混沌与扰乱紧密对应，而Rabi大频率比极限中该对应破缺；混沌行为的差异来自经典自由度数目不同，相似的扰乱行为则源于本征态离域。
3. 这一对比表明，仅凭本征态离域不足以将Rabi模型判定为经典混沌模型，识别量子混沌需同时考量经典自由度与本征态离域。

title: NeST: ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes with sub-$50μ$s stabiliser cycles via spin shuttling
abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check codes now reach encoding rates up to 50% at useful distances. Their checks however are long-range group actions, not local neighbourhoods, and that connectivity has so far been supplied by neutral atoms. Silicon spin qubits offer the same primitive --- coherent transport of qubit blocks --- through electron shuttling, and on microsecond rather than millisecond timescales. They however travel along fabricated tracks rather than free space: permutations an atom array obtains by moving tweezers must here become collision-free motions on a physical lattice. We here present the first code and spin-qubit hardware co-design. We build an architecture whose geometry mimics that of a family of non-abelian groups, broad enough to host codes of excellent parameters: a hierarchy of nested conveyor-belt loops on a plain square lattice of shuttling tracks, in which every group multiplication becomes a rigid, globally controlled motion of whole qubit trains. We call it NeST, for Nested Shuttling Tracks. A code search over the family returns rate-20% mitten codes up to $[[1400,280,\leq 28]]$, and circuit-level simulations including shuttling dephasing give thresholds above $10^{-3}$ with sub-$50\mu$s stabiliser cycles, two to three orders of magnitude faster than neutral-atom implementations. Via extrapolations, we estimate that this largest code may reach a logical error probability per qubit per round of $10^{-14}$, assuming a ten-fold improvement on early shuttling demonstrations, with other physical errors at p=0.1%. Logic is compatible with NeST too: for the [[150,30,10]] code we build a code-surgery gadget in which every qubit again moves only by rigid belt motions, at no qubit cost and a 29% increase in gate layers. This demonstrates that ultra-low-overhead fault tolerance and a fast clock speed are not competing goals, and that silicon spin qubits can supply both.
summary:
1. 该工作提出首个码与硅自旋量子硬件协同设计的NeST架构，利用方形晶格上的嵌套传送带环，将长程qLDPC校验实现为全局刚性穿梭运动。
2. 其卖点是把非阿贝尔群乘法映射为无碰撞的整列量子比特平移，含穿梭退相干的电路级模拟给出速率20%、[[1400,280,≤28]]的mitten码，阈值超10^-3且稳定子周期低于50 μs。
3. 这显示超低开销容错与快速时钟可兼得：外推下早期穿梭提升十倍、其他错误0.1%时，最大码每轮每比特逻辑错误率约10^-14，并为码手术等逻辑操作保留兼容路径。

title: Complete Modified Logarithmic Sobolev Inequalities for one-dimensional quantum Spin Chain
abstract: We prove a complete modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality with a system-size-independent constant for Chen--Kastoryano--Gilyén Gibbs samplers on one-dimensional spin chain at every fixed positive temperature. The result holds for Hamiltonians with bounded finite-range interactions, including noncommuting and spatially nonuniform interactions. It yields trace and diamond mixing times of order $O(\log N+\log(1/\epsilon))$. The proof establishes complete spatial entropy factorization and absorbs quasi-local errors as conditional relative entropy at the original joint state and reference. The static estimate also yields a system-size-independent CMLSI for the single-site Petz heat-bath and regularised heat-bath dynamics.
summary:
1. 该工作证明了一维量子自旋链上 Chen–Kastoryano–Gilyén Gibbs 采样器在任意固定正温度下具有尺寸无关常数的完全修正对数 Sobolev 不等式，覆盖有界有限程、非对易与非均匀相互作用。
2. 其卖点是建立完全空间熵分解，并将准局域误差吸收为原联合态与参考态间的条件相对熵，由此得到 O(log N+log(1/ε)) 的迹与钻石混合时间。
3. 该静态估计进一步给出单点 Petz 热浴及正则化热浴动力学的尺寸无关 CMLSI，为有限程量子自旋链的高效 Gibbs 采样与混合分析提供了可推广启发。
